1ST MACCABEES 1:31  And he took preys of the city, and burnt it with fire, and destroyed houses thereof, and walls thereof in compass.
1ST MACCABEES 1:32  And they led (the) women captive, and children, and wielded (the) beasts.
1ST MACCABEES 1:33  And they builded the city of David with [a] great wall and firm, and firm towers; and it was made to them into an high tower, either strength (or a stronghold).
1ST MACCABEES 1:34  And they putted there a folk of sinners, wicked men, and they were strong in it;
1ST MACCABEES 1:35  and they putted arms, and meats (or food), and gathered (the) preys of Jerusalem; and putted up there, and were made into a great snare.
1ST MACCABEES 1:36  And this thing was made into espyings in evil, either treasons, to (the) hallowing (or against the Temple), and into an evil devil in Israel evermore.
1ST MACCABEES 1:37  And they shed out innocent blood, by compass of the hallowing (or all around the Temple), and defouled the hallowing (or and defiled the Temple).
1ST MACCABEES 1:38  And (the) dwellers of Jerusalem fled for them, and it was made (an) habitation of strangers, and it was made strange, either alien, to his seed, and (the) sons thereof forsook it.
1ST MACCABEES 1:39  The hallowing thereof (or Its Temple) was (as) desolate as (a) wilder-ness; (the) feast days thereof were turned into mourning, (the) sabbaths thereof into shame (or reproof), (and the) honours thereof into nought.
1ST MACCABEES 1:40  By [or After] the glory thereof, the evil fame thereof was multiplied, and (the) highness thereof was turned into mourning.
1ST MACCABEES 1:41  And king Antiochus wrote to all his realm, that all the people should be one.
1ST MACCABEES 1:42  And they forsook each man his law; and all folks consented by [or after] the word of king Antiochus,
1ST MACCABEES 1:43  and many of Israel consented to him, and sacrificed to idols, and defouled (or defiled the) sabbath.
1ST MACCABEES 1:44  And king Antiochus sent books by the hands of messengers into Jerusalem, and into all cities of Judea, that they should pursue (or follow the) laws of (the) folks of (the) earth,
1ST MACCABEES 1:45  and should forbid burnt sacrifices, and sacrifices, and pleasings for to be done in the temple of God, and that they should forbid the sabbath for to be hallowed, and solemn days,
1ST MACCABEES 1:46  and holy things for to be defouled (or and that they should defile the Temple), and the holy people of Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 1:47  And he commanded altars for to be builded, and temples, and idols; and swine’s flesh for to be sacrificed, and unclean beasts;
1ST MACCABEES 1:48  and for to leave their sons uncircumcised, and the souls of them for to be defouled in all uncleanness-es and abominations,
1ST MACCABEES 1:49  so that they should forget the law, and should change all the justifyings of God.
1ST MACCABEES 1:50  And (that) whoever did not by the word of king Antiochus, should die.
1ST MACCABEES 1:51  By all these words he wrote to all his realm, and above-set [or before-set] princes to the people, which should constrain these things for to be done. And they commanded to (the) cities of Judea for to make sacrifice.
1ST MACCABEES 1:52  And many of the people were gathered to them, which forsook the law of the Lord, and did evils on earth.
1ST MACCABEES 1:53  And they drived [or drove] out the people of Israel from (or into) privy places, and in(to) hid places of (or for) fugitives, either fleeing men.
1ST MACCABEES 1:54  In the fifteenth day of the month Kislev, that answereth to our November, in the hundred and five and fortieth year, king Antiochus builded (the) abominable idol of desolation, either[or (of)]discomfort, on the altar of God; and by all (the) cities of Judea in compass they builded altars.
1ST MACCABEES 1:55  And before the gates of the houses and in streets, they burnt incenses, and sacrificed;
1ST MACCABEES 1:56  and burnt by fire the books of the law of God, and carved them (up).
1ST MACCABEES 1:57  And with whomever the books of [the] testament of the Lord were found, and whoever kept the law of the Lord, by [or after] the commandment of the king, they slew him.
1ST MACCABEES 1:58  In their virtue, either power, they did these things to the people of Israel, that was found in each month in the cities.
1ST MACCABEES 1:59  And in the five and twentieth day of the month, they sacrificed on the (idol) altar, that was against (or on top of) the altar of God.
1ST MACCABEES 1:60  And women, that circumcised their sons, were strangled, by [or after](the) commandment of king Antiochus;
1ST MACCABEES 1:61  and they hanged (the) children by the necks, by all houses of them, and strangled them that circumcised them.
1ST MACCABEES 1:62  And many of the people of Israel determined, either fully deemed, with-(in) them(selves), that they should not eat unclean things,
1ST MACCABEES 1:63  and choosed more for to die, than for to be defouled with unclean meats. And they would not break the holy law of God, and they were slain;
1ST MACCABEES 1:64  and full great wrath was made on the people (of Israel).
1ST MACCABEES 2:1  In those days Mattathias, the son of John, son of Simeon, and he was a priest of the sons of Joarib, rose from Jerusalem, and sat in the hill Modin.
1ST MACCABEES 2:2  And he had five sons; John, (that) was named Gaddis;
1ST MACCABEES 2:3  and Simon, that was named Thassis;
1ST MACCABEES 2:4  and Judas, that was called Maccabeus;
1ST MACCABEES 2:5  and Eleazar, that was named Avaran; and Jonathan, that was named Apphus.
1ST MACCABEES 2:6  These saw the evils that were done in the people of Judea and Jerusalem.
1ST MACCABEES 2:7  And Mattathias said, Woe to me! whereto am I born, for to see the destroying of my people, and the defouling of the holy city, and for to sit there, when it is given into the hands of (our) enemies? Holy things be made in the hand of strangers (or The Temple is given into the hands of strangers);
1ST MACCABEES 2:8  the temple thereof (is) as a man unnoble;
1ST MACCABEES 2:9  (the) vessels of glory thereof be led away captive. Eld [or Old] men thereof be slain in (the) streets, and young men thereof fell down by (the) sword of (the) enemies.
1ST MACCABEES 2:10  What folk inherited not the kingdom thereof, and wielded not (the) preys thereof?
1ST MACCABEES 2:11  All (the) adorning thereof is borne away; she that was free, is made the handmaiden.
1ST MACCABEES 2:12  And lo! our holy thing, and our fairness, and our clarity, is desolate, and heathen men defouled it.
1ST MACCABEES 2:13  What therefore is it to us for to live (any longer)?
1ST MACCABEES 2:14  And Mattathias and his sons rent their clothes, and covered them(selves) with hair-shirts, and wailed greatly.
1ST MACCABEES 2:15  And they that were sent of (or by) king Antiochus, came thither, for to constrain them that fled together into the city of Modin, for to offer and burn incenses, and for to depart from the law of God.
1ST MACCABEES 2:16  And many of the people of Israel consented, and came to them; but Mat-tathias and his sons stood steadfastly.
1ST MACCABEES 2:17  And they answered, that were sent of (or by) Antiochus, and said to Mat-tathias, Thou art (a) prince, and most clear (or glorious), and great in this city, and adorned with sons and brethren.
1ST MACCABEES 2:18  Therefore go thou the former (or the first), and do the commandment of the king, as all folks have done, and men of Judea, and they that (be) left in Jerusalem. And thou shalt be, and thy sons, among (the) friends of the king, and made large in silver and gold, and many gifts.
1ST MACCABEES 2:19  And Mattathias answered, and said with (a) great (or a loud) voice, Though all (the) folks obey to king Antiochus, (so) that they go away each man from the service of the law of his fathers, and consent to his commandments,
1ST MACCABEES 2:20  I, and my sons, and my brethren shall obey to the law of our fathers.
1ST MACCABEES 2:21  God be helpful to us; it is not profitable to us for to forsake the law, and (the) rightfulnesses of God.
1ST MACCABEES 2:22  We shall not hear the words of king Antiochus, neither shall make sacrifice/s to idols, and break the commandments of our law, that we go by another way.
1ST MACCABEES 2:23  And as he ceased for to speak these words, some Jew went to, before the eyes of all men, for to sacrifice to idols on the altar, in the city of Modin, by [or after](the) commandment of the king.
1ST MACCABEES 2:24  And Mattathias saw, and sorrowed, and his reins trembled together, and his madness, that is, great wrath by (his) fervent love, was kindled by [or after](the) doom of the law; and he leaped in, and slew him on the altar.
1ST MACCABEES 2:25  But and (or also) he slew in that time the man whom king Antiochus sent, which compelled (them) for to offer, and he destroyed the altar.
1ST MACCABEES 2:26  And he loved fervently the law, as Phinehas did to Zimri, son of Salu.
1ST MACCABEES 2:27  And Mattathias cried with (a) great (or a loud) voice in the city, and said, Each man that hath fervent love of (or for) the law, ordain a testament, that is, a covenant, and go he out after me.
1ST MACCABEES 2:28  And he flew (or fled), and his sons, into (the) mountains, and left whatever things they had in the city.
1ST MACCABEES 2:29  Then many seeking doom and rightwiseness, went down into (the) desert, that they should sit there,
1ST MACCABEES 2:30  they and the sons of them, and (the) women of them, and (the) beasts of them; for evils were hard on them.
1ST MACCABEES 2:31  And it was told to men of the king, and to the host, that were in Jerusalem, [in] the city of David, that some men went away, that destroyed the commandment of the king, into privy places in (the) desert; and many had gone after them.
1ST MACCABEES 2:32  And anon (or at once) they went to (or after) them, and ordained against them battle, in the day of sabbaths;
1ST MACCABEES 2:33  and said to them, Against-stand ye also now yet? go ye out, and do after the word of king Antiochus, and ye shall live.
1ST MACCABEES 2:34  And they said, We shall not go out, neither [we] shall do the word of the king, that we defoul the day of sabbaths.
1ST MACCABEES 2:35  And they stirred battle against them.
1ST MACCABEES 2:36  And they answered not to them, neither threw a stone to (or at) them, neither stopped privy places,
1ST MACCABEES 2:37  and said, Die we all in our simple-ness (or our innocence), and heaven and earth shall be witnesses on (or for) us, that unjustly ye lose (or destroy) us.
1ST MACCABEES 2:38  And they gave to them battle in (or on the) sabbaths, and they were dead, and (the) wives of them, and (the) sons of them, and (the) beasts of them, till to a thousand persons of men.
1ST MACCABEES 2:39  And Mattathias knew, and his friends; and they had mourning on them greatly.
1ST MACCABEES 2:40  And a man said to his neighbor, If we all shall do as our brethren did, and shall not fight against (the) heathen men, for our lives, and our justifyings, the sooner they shall destroy us from (off) the earth.
1ST MACCABEES 2:41  And they thought in that day, and said, Each man whoever cometh to us in battle, in the day of sabbaths, fight we against him, and die we not all, as our brethren be dead in privy places.
1ST MACCABEES 2:42  Then the synagogue of (the) Jews, strong in mights of Israel, was gathered to them. Every willful (or willing) man in the law,
1ST MACCABEES 2:43  and all that fled from evils, were added to them, and they were made to them to steadfastness.
1ST MACCABEES 2:44  And they gathered an host, and smited sinners in their wrath, and wicked men in their indignation; and the others fled to nations, for to escape.
1ST MACCABEES 2:45  And Mattathias environed, and his friends, and destroyed (the) altars,
1ST MACCABEES 2:46  and circumcised children uncir-cumcised, how many ever they found in the coasts of Israel, in strength.
1ST MACCABEES 2:47  And they pursued the sons of pride, and the work had prosperity in their hands.
1ST MACCABEES 2:48  And they got the law from (or out of) the hands of (the) heathen men, and from (or out of) the hands of kings, and gave not strength to the sinner.
1ST MACCABEES 2:49  And (the) days of Mattathias of (or for) dying nighed, and he said to his sons, Now pride is comforted, and chastising, and time of destruction, and the wrath of indignation.
1ST MACCABEES 2:50  Now therefore, sons, be ye pur-suers, either lovers, of the law, and give ye your lives for the testament (or the covenant) of (our) fathers.
1ST MACCABEES 2:51  And bethink ye on the works of (our) fathers, which they did in their generations, and ye shall receive great glory, and (an) everlasting name.
1ST MACCABEES 2:52  Whether in temptation Abraham was not found true, either faithful, and it was areckoned to him to rightwiseness?
1ST MACCABEES 2:53  Joseph, in (the) time of his anguish, kept (the) commandment, and was made lord of Egypt.
1ST MACCABEES 2:54  Phinehas, our father, in fervently loving the fervent love of God, took testament (or received the covenant) of (an) everlasting priesthood.
1ST MACCABEES 2:55  Jesus, either Joshua, while he [ful] filled the word, was made (a) duke in Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 2:56  Caleb, while he witnessed in the church (or before the congregation), took heritage (or received the inheritance).
1ST MACCABEES 2:57  David, in (or for) his mercy, got the seat of (the) kingdom, into worlds.
1ST MACCABEES 2:58  Elijah, while he fervently loved the fervent love of the law, was received into heaven.
1ST MACCABEES 2:59  Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael, believed, and were delivered from the flame.
1ST MACCABEES 2:60  Daniel, in his simpleness (or his integrity), was delivered from the mouth of lions.
1ST MACCABEES 2:61  And thus bethink ye by generation and generation, for all that hope into him be not made unsteadfast.
1ST MACCABEES 2:62  And dread ye not of the words of a man a sinner, for the glory of him is turd(s) and worm(s);
1ST MACCABEES 2:63  today he is enhanced (or is exalted), and tomorrow he shall not be found, for he is (re)turned into his earth, and his thought shall perish.
1ST MACCABEES 2:64  Therefore, ye sons, be comforted (or strengthened), and do ye manly in the law; for when ye shall do those things that be bidden to you in the law of your Lord God, in it ye shall be glorious.
1ST MACCABEES 2:65  And lo! Simon, your brother; I know, that he is a man of counsel, hear ye him evermore, and he shall be (a) father to you.
1ST MACCABEES 2:66  And Judas Maccabeus, strong in mights from his youth, be to you a prince in [or of](the) knighthood, and he shall do (the) battle of (or for) the people.
1ST MACCABEES 2:67  And ye shall bring to you all (the) doers of the law, and avenge ye the vengeance of your people.
1ST MACCABEES 2:68  Yield ye yielding to (the) heathen men, and take ye attention to the behest(s), (or commandments,) of the law.
1ST MACCABEES 2:69  And he blessed them, and was put to his fathers.
1ST MACCABEES 2:70  And he was dead in the hundred and six and fortieth year, and was buried of (or by) his sons into (the) sepulchre of his fathers in Modin; and all Israel wailed him with great wailing.
1ST MACCABEES 3:1  And Judas, that was called Maccabeus, the son of Mattathias, rose (up) for him.
1ST MACCABEES 3:2  And all his brethren helped him, and all that joined them(selves) to his father, and they fought the battle of Israel with gladness.
1ST MACCABEES 3:3  And he alarged (or enlarged) glory to his people, and clothed him(self) with an habergeon as a giant, and girt him(self) with his armours of battle in battles, and defended castles (or the host, or his army) with his sword.
1ST MACCABEES 3:4  He was made like a lion in his works, and as a whelp of a lion roaring in his hunting.
1ST MACCABEES 3:5  And he pursued wicked men, and sought them (out); and he burnt them in flames, that disturbed, or troubled, his people.
1ST MACCABEES 3:6  And his enemies were put aback for dread of him, and all workers of wick-edness were troubled (al)together; and health was (ad)dressed in his hand (or deliverance was directed by his hand).
1ST MACCABEES 3:7  And he wrathed many kings, and gladded Jacob, that is, the people of Israel, in his works, and into (the) world his mind (or memory)is in blessing.
1ST MACCABEES 3:8  And he went through the cities of Judea, and lost unpious men of them, and turned away wrath from Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 3:9  And he was named till to the utmost of (the) earth, and he gathered men perishing.
1ST MACCABEES 3:10  And Apollonius gathered (the) folks, and from Samaria much virtue, and great, (or a very great host, or army), for to fight against Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 3:11  And Judas knew, and went out against him, and smote, and slew him. And many wounded fell down, and the others fled;
1ST MACCABEES 3:12  and he took (the) preys of them. And Judas took away the sword of Apollonius, and was fighting there-with in all (his) days.
1ST MACCABEES 3:13  And Seron, (a) prince of the host of Syria, heard, that Judas gathered a gathering, and the church (or the con-gregation) of faithful men with him.
1ST MACCABEES 3:14  And he said, I shall make to me a name, and I shall be glorified in the realm, and I shall overcome Judas, and them that be with him, which despised the king’s word.
1ST MACCABEES 3:15  And he made ready him(self); and the castles (or the host) of unpious men, strong helpers, went up with him, for to do vengeance on the sons of Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 3:16  And they nighed unto Bethhoron; and Judas went out against them, with (a) few men.
1ST MACCABEES 3:17  Forsooth as they saw the host coming to them in meeting, they said to Judas, How may we few fight against so great (a) multitude, so strong; and we be made weary by fasting this day?
1ST MACCABEES 3:18  And Judas said, It is light, either easy, that many be closed (up)(al)to-gether in (the) hand(s) of (a) few; and difference is not in (the) sight of God of heaven, for to deliver in (or with) many either in (or with a) few;
1ST MACCABEES 3:19  for not in (the) multitude of host is the victory of battle, but of (or from) heaven is strength.
1ST MACCABEES 3:20  They come to us in rebel multitude, and pride, for to destroy us, and our wives, and our sons, and for to rob us.
1ST MACCABEES 3:21  Forsooth we shall fight for our lives, and our laws;
1ST MACCABEES 3:22  and the Lord himself shall all-break them before our face; forsooth dread ye not them.
1ST MACCABEES 3:23  Soothly as he ceased for to speak, he hurled into them suddenly; and Seron was all-broken, and his host, in the sight of him.
1ST MACCABEES 3:24  And he pursued him in the going down of Bethhoron, till into the field; and eight hundred men of them fell down, the others forsooth fled into the land of (the) Philistines.
1ST MACCABEES 3:25  And the dread of Judas, and of his brethren, and the inward fearedness, fell on all (the) heathen men in (the) compass of them;
1ST MACCABEES 3:26  and the name of him came to the king, and all (the) folks told of the battles of Judas.
1ST MACCABEES 3:27  Soothly as king Antiochus heard these words, he was wroth in soul; and he sent, and gathered the host of all his realm, full strong castles (or host).
1ST MACCABEES 3:28  And he opened his treasury, and gave solds (or wages) to his host, into a year, and commanded them, that they should be ready to all things.
1ST MACCABEES 3:29  And (then) he saw, that money failed of (or from) his treasures, and (the) tributes of the country were little, for (the) dissention and vengeance that he did in the land, for to do away the lawful things that were of the first days.
1ST MACCABEES 3:30  And he dreaded, that he should not have as once and twice into (the) costs and gifts, which he had given before with (a) large hand; and he was rich over kings that were before him.
1ST MACCABEES 3:31  And he was astonished in soul greatly, and thought for to go into Persia, and for to take tributes of (or from the) countries, and for to gather much silver.
1ST MACCABEES 3:32  And (so) he left Lysias, a noble man of the king’s kin, on (or over) the king’s needs, from the flood (or river) Euphrates, till to the flood of Egypt;
1ST MACCABEES 3:33  and that he should nourish (up) Antiochus, his son, till he came again.
1ST MACCABEES 3:34  And he betook to him the half of his host, and elephants, and command-ed to him of all these things that he would (have done), and of (the) men inhabiting Judea and Jerusalem;
1ST MACCABEES 3:35  and that he should send to them a host, for to all-break, and to destroy utterly the virtue (or strength) of Israel, and the reliefs (or remnants) of Jeru-salem, and for to do away the mind (or memory) of them from (that) place;
1ST MACCABEES 3:36  and for to ordain (as) dwellers (the) sons (of) aliens in all the coasts of them, and by lot for to part the land of them.
1ST MACCABEES 3:37  And the king took a part of the residue host, and went out of (or from) Antioch, (the) city of his realm, in the hundred and seven and fortieth year; and passed over the flood Euphrates, and went through the higher countries.
1ST MACCABEES 3:38  And Lysias chose Ptolemy, the son of Dorymenes, and Nicanor, and Gorgias, mighty men of the king’s friends.
1ST MACCABEES 3:39  And he sent with them forty thousand of men, and seven thousand of horsemen, either knights, that they should come into the land of Judea, and destroy it, by [or after] the word of the king.
1ST MACCABEES 3:40  And they went forth, for to go with all their power; and they came, and landed (or encamped) at Emmaus, in the field land.
1ST MACCABEES 3:41  And (the) merchants of countries (or the country) heard the name of them, and took silver and gold full much, and children (or servants), and came into castles (or the camp), for to take the sons of Israel into servants (or slaves); and the hosts of Syria, and (of) the lands of aliens, were added to them.
1ST MACCABEES 3:42  And Judas saw, and his brethren, that evils were multiplied, and the host applied, or landed, (or encamped) at the coasts of them; and they knew the words of the king, which he commanded the people for to do, into perishing and ending.
1ST MACCABEES 3:43  And they said, each man to his neighbour, Raise we (up) the casting down of our people, and fight we for our people, and our holy things.
1ST MACCABEES 3:44  And (the) coming together of (the) host was gathered, for to be ready into battle, and for to pray, and ask (for) mercy, and (for) merciful doings.
1ST MACCABEES 3:45  And Jerusalem was not inhabited, but was as (a) desert; there was not that entered and went out, of (its) children thereof; and the holy thing was defouled (or and the Temple was defiled), and (the) sons of aliens were in the high tower, (yea), there was the dwelling of (the) heathen men; and the liking (or joy) was done away from Jacob, and pipe and harp failed there.
1ST MACCABEES 3:46  And they were gathered, and came into Mizpeh (over) against (or opposite) Jerusalem; for (the) place of prayer was in Mizpeh, sooner, (or earlier), [or before] then in Jerusalem.
1ST MACCABEES 3:47  And they fasted in that day, and clothed them(selves) with hair-shirts, and putted ashes in (or on) their head(s), and rent their clothes.
1ST MACCABEES 3:48  And they spreaded abroad (the) books of the law, (out) of the which (the) heathen men sought (the) likeness of their simulacra (or idols, or images);
1ST MACCABEES 3:49  and they brought (the) ornaments of (the) priests, and (the) first fruits, and (the) tithes; and they raised (or stirred up the) Nazirites, that had [ful] filled (their) days.
1ST MACCABEES 3:50  And they cried with (a) great (or a loud) voice to heaven, and said, What shall we do to (or with) these, and whither shall we lead them?
1ST MACCABEES 3:51  And thine holy things be trodden, and defouled (or And thy Temple is trodden down, and defiled), and thy priests be made into mourning, and into casting down, either despising.
1ST MACCABEES 3:52  And lo! (the) nations came together against us, for to destroy us; thou know-est what things they think against us.
1ST MACCABEES 3:53  How shall we be able to with-stand before the face of them, no but thou, God, help us?
1ST MACCABEES 3:54  And they cried in (or with) trumps, (and) with (a) great (or a loud) voice.
1ST MACCABEES 3:55  And after these things Judas or-dained dukes of the people, tribunes, that is, [one]leading a thousand, and centurions, ( one) leading an hundred, and pentacontrarks, (one) leading fifty, and decurions, (one) leading ten.
1ST MACCABEES 3:56  And he said to these that builded houses, and wedded wives, and plant-ed vineyards, and to dreadful men, that they should (re)turn again, each man into his house, by [or after] the law.
1ST MACCABEES 3:57  And they moved castles, either (the) host (s) of armed men, and they setted together at the south of Emmaus.
1ST MACCABEES 3:58  And Judas said, Be ye gird, and be ye mighty sons, and be ye ready in the morrowing, and (so) that ye fight against these nations, that came together for to destroy us, and our holy things (or our Temple).
1ST MACCABEES 3:59  For better it is, that we die in battle, than for to see evils of our folk, and holy things (or of our Temple).
1ST MACCABEES 3:60  Soothly as (the) will (of God) shall be in heaven, so be it done.
1ST MACCABEES 4:1  And Gorgias took five thousand of men, and a thousand chosen horsemen; and they moved (the) tents by night,
1ST MACCABEES 4:2  for to apply to (or to attack) the tents of (the) Jews, and for to smite them suddenly; and (the) sons that were of the high tower, were (the) leaders of them.
1ST MACCABEES 4:3  And Judas heard (of this), and he rose (up), and (his) mighty men, for to smite the power of (the) hosts of the king, that was in Emmaus;
1ST MACCABEES 4:4  for yet the host was scattered from (the) tents.
1ST MACCABEES 4:5  And Gorgias came into the tents of Judas by night, and found no man; and they sought them in (the) hills, for he said, These flee from us.
1ST MACCABEES 4:6  And when day was made, Judas appeared in the field with three thousands of men only, which had not coverings and swords.
1ST MACCABEES 4:7  And they saw the tents of (the) heathen men strong, and (the) men habergeoned, and the multitude of horsemen in compass of them, and these were taught to battle.
1ST MACCABEES 4:8  And Judas said to his men, that were with him, Dread ye not the multitude of them, and dread ye not inwardly the fierceness of them.
1ST MACCABEES 4:9  Bethink ye how our fathers were made safe in the Red Sea, when Pharaoh pursued them with much host.
1ST MACCABEES 4:10  And now cry we to heaven, and the Lord shall have mercy on us, and shall be mindful of the testament of our fathers, and shall all-break this host before our face today.
1ST MACCABEES 4:11  And (then) all (the) folks shall know, that it is God, that shall again-buy (or who shall redeem), and deliver Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 4:12  And (the) aliens raised (up) their eyes, and saw them coming of (or from) the contrary part, [or even against (them)],
1ST MACCABEES 4:13  and went out of (the) tents into battle. And they that were with Judas, sang in (or with) trump(s).
1ST MACCABEES 4:14  And they went together, and (the) heathen men were all-broken, and fled into the field;
1ST MACCABEES 4:15  forsooth the last fell down by (the) sword. And they pursued them till to Gazara, and till into the fields of Idumea (or Edom), and Azotus, and Jamnia; and there fell down of them till to three thousands of men.
1ST MACCABEES 4:16  And Judas (re)turned again, and his host pursuing him.
1ST MACCABEES 4:17  And he said to the people, Covet ye not (the) preys, for (a) battle is against us (or is before us),
1ST MACCABEES 4:18  and Gorgias and his host be in the hill nigh us; but stand ye now against our enemies, and overcome them, and after these things ye shall take preys securely (or boldly take the prey).
1ST MACCABEES 4:19  And yet while Judas spake these things, lo! some part (of them) appear-ed, beholding forth from the hill.
1ST MACCABEES 4:20  And Gorgias saw, that his helpers were (al)together turned into flight, and tents were burnt; for (the) smoke that was seen, declared that that was done.
1ST MACCABEES 4:21  And when they beheld these things, they dreaded greatly, beholding together both Judas and the host, ready to (or for) battle in the field.
1ST MACCABEES 4:22  And they fled all in(to) the field of aliens,
1ST MACCABEES 4:23  and Judas (re)turned again to (the) preys of the tents; and they took much gold, and silver, and jacinth, and purple of the sea, and great riches.
1ST MACCABEES 4:24  And they converted (or turned and went back), and sung an hymn, or praising, and blessed God into heaven; for he is good, for the mercy of him is into the world (or evermore).
1ST MACCABEES 4:25  And great health (or deliverance) was made in Israel in that day.
1ST MACCABEES 4:26  Forsooth whoever of (the) aliens (had) escaped, came, and told to Lysias all (the) things that befell.
1ST MACCABEES 4:27  And when he heard these things, he was astonished in soul, and failed; for not what manner things he would, such befell in Israel, and what manner things the king commanded.
1ST MACCABEES 4:28  And in the year pursuing, Lysias gathered of chosen men sixty thousand, and of horsemen five thousand, for to overcome them.
1ST MACCABEES 4:29  And they came into Judea, and setted tents in Bethhoron (or And they came into Idumea, and set up their tents in Bethsura); and Judas ran to them with ten thousand of men.
1ST MACCABEES 4:30  And they saw (the) strong host, and he prayed, and said, Blessed art thou, (O) Saviour of Israel, that hast all-broken the fierceness of the mighty Goliath in the hand of thy servant David, and betookest the castles [or tents], or hosts, of (the) aliens into the hands of Jonathan, son of Saul, and of his squire.
1ST MACCABEES 4:31  Close thou (up)(al)together also this host in the hand of thy people Israel, and be they confounded in their host, and horsemen.
1ST MACCABEES 4:32  Give thou to them inward dread, and make the hardiness of their virtue to fail, and be they moved (al)together in their breaking (al)together.
1ST MACCABEES 4:33  Cast down them by the sword of men loving thee, and all that know thy name, (al)together praise thee in hymns.
1ST MACCABEES 4:34  And they joined together battle, and five thousand of men fell down of the host of Lysias.
1ST MACCABEES 4:35  Lysias forsooth saw the flight of his men, and the hardiness of (the) Jews; and that they were ready either for to live, either for to die strongly. And he went to Antioch, and chose knights, that they multiplied should come again into Judea.
1ST MACCABEES 4:36  Forsooth Judas said to his brethren [or Forsooth Judas said, and his brethren], Lo! our enemies be all-broken; go we up or ascend we now, for to cleanse (the) holy things (or the Temple), and make (it) new (again).
1ST MACCABEES 4:37  And all the host was gathered, and they went up into the hill of Zion.
1ST MACCABEES 4:38  And they saw (the) hallowing (or Temple) desert(ed), either forsaken, and the altar unhallowed, or defouled by idolatry, and the gates burnt, and in the porches tender trees grown, as in (the) wild wood, or (the) mountains, and (the) little cells destroyed.
1ST MACCABEES 4:39  And they rent their clothes, and wailed with great wailing; and putted ashes on their head(s),
1ST MACCABEES 4:40  and fell on the face of the earth, and cried in (or with the) trumps of signs, and cried into heaven.
1ST MACCABEES 4:41  Then Judas ordained men, for to fight against them that were in the high tower, as long as (or until) they cleansed holy things (or the Temple).
1ST MACCABEES 4:42  And he chose priests without wem, having will in (or for) the law of God;
1ST MACCABEES 4:43  and they cleansed (the) holy things (or Temple), and took away (the) stones of defouling into an unclean place.
1ST MACCABEES 4:44  And he thought on the altar of burnt sacrifices, that was unhallowed, (and) what he should do thereof.
1ST MACCABEES 4:45  And a good counsel fell into him, for to destroy it, lest it were to them into shame (or reproof), for (the) heathen men (had) defouled it.
1ST MACCABEES 4:46  And (so) they destroyed it, and kept [or putted](the) stones in the hill of the house, in (a) covenable (or a suitable) place, till that a prophet came, and answered of (or for) them.
1ST MACCABEES 4:47  And they took whole stones, by [or after] the law, and builded a new altar, like that that was (there) before.
1ST MACCABEES 4:48  And they builded holy things (or the Temple), and the things that were within the house withinforth; and they hallowed the house, and the porches.
1ST MACCABEES 4:49  And they made new holy vessels, and brought in a candlestick, and (the) altar of incenses, and a board (or a table) into the temple.
1ST MACCABEES 4:50  And [they] putted incense on the altar, and tended (the) lanterns, that were on the candlestick, and gave light in the temple.
1ST MACCABEES 4:51  And they putted loaves on the board (or table), and hanged veils, and ended all (the) works that they made.
1ST MACCABEES 4:52  And before morrowtide they rose (up), in the five and twentieth day of the ninth month, this is the month Kislev, that is, November-December, of the hundred and eight and fortieth year.
1ST MACCABEES 4:53  And they offered sacrifice by [or after] the law, on the new altar of burnt sacrifices, which they made by [or after](a) time.
1ST MACCABEES 4:54  And by the day in which heathen men defouled it, in (or on) that (day), it was made new, in songs, and harps, and citherns, that be instruments of music, either gitterns, and cymbals.
1ST MACCABEES 4:55  And all the people fell on their face(s), and worshipped God, and blessed into heaven him that made prosperity to (or for) them.
1ST MACCABEES 4:56  And (so) they made (the) hallow-ing of the altar in (or for) eight days, and offered burnt sacrifices with glad-ness, and helpful things of praising.
1ST MACCABEES 4:57  And they adorned the face of the temple with golden crowns, and small shields; and hallowed (the) gates, and (the) little houses, either small cells, and putted (on)to them gates (or doors).
1ST MACCABEES 4:58  And full great gladness was made in the people, and the shame of heathen men was turned away.
1ST MACCABEES 4:59  And Judas ordained, and his brethren, and all the church (or all the congregation) of Israel, that the day of hallowing of the altar be done in his (or its) times, from year into year, by eight days, from the five and twen-tieth day of the month Kislev, that is, December, with gladness and joy.
1ST MACCABEES 4:60  And they builded in that time the hill of Zion, and by compass high walls, and firm towers, lest any time (the) heathen men would come, and defoul it, as they did before.
1ST MACCABEES 4:61  And he set there an host, for to keep it; and he warded it, for to keep Bethsura, (so) that the people should have strengthening [or warding] against the face of Idumea (or of Edom).
1ST MACCABEES 5:1  And it was done, as heathen men heard in compass, that the altar was builded, and the saintuary (or sanctuary) as before, they were wroth greatly.
1ST MACCABEES 5:2  And they thought for to do away, either destroy, the kin of Jacob, that was among them; and they began for to slay of the people, and pursue (after them).
1ST MACCABEES 5:3  And Judas overcame the sons of Esau in Idumea, and them that were in Acrabattene, for they sat about (the) men of Israel; and he smote them with a great wound.
1ST MACCABEES 5:4  And he thought on the malice of the sons of Bean, that were into (a) snare, and into (an) offence to the people of Israel, and espied it, either set ambushments to it, in (or on) the way(s).
1ST MACCABEES 5:5  And these were closed (up)(al)to-gether from him in the towers; and he applied to them (or he encamped near them), and cursed them, and burnt with fire the towers of them, with all (the) men that were in them.
1ST MACCABEES 5:6  And he passed (over) to the sons of Ammon, and found (a) strong hand, and plenteous people, and Timothy (or Timotheus), (the) duke of them.
1ST MACCABEES 5:7  And he smote many battles with them, and they were broken in (or at) the sight of him; and he smote them.
1ST MACCABEES 5:8  And he took the city (of) Jazer, and (the) villages thereof; and he (re)turned again into Judea.
1ST MACCABEES 5:9  And (the) heathen men that were in Gilead, were gathered against (the) Israelites, that were in the coasts of them, to do away them [or do them away]; and they fled into the strength-ening (or the stronghold) of Dathema.
1ST MACCABEES 5:10  And they sent letters to Judas, and his brethren, and said, (The) Heathen men be gathered against us by compass, that they do away us [or do us away];
1ST MACCABEES 5:11  and they make ready for to come, and occupy the strengthening (or the stronghold), into which we fled; and Timothy is duke of the host of them.
1ST MACCABEES 5:12  Now therefore come thou, and deliver us from their hands, for a multitude of us fell down;
1ST MACCABEES 5:13  and all our brethren that were in places of Tubias, everywhere be slain; and they led away captive the wives of them, and children, and took spoils; and killed there almost a thousand men.
1ST MACCABEES 5:14  And yet (while these) epistles were read, and lo! other messengers came from Galilee, with coats rent (or torn), and told by these words,
1ST MACCABEES 5:15  and said, that men came together against them from Ptolemais, and Tyre, and Sidon, and all Galilee is [full]-filled with aliens, for to destroy us.
1ST MACCABEES 5:16  Soothly as Judas heard, and the people, these words, a great church (or a great congregation) came together, for to think what they should do to (or for) their brethren, that were in tribulation, and were overcome of (or by) them.
1ST MACCABEES 5:17  And Judas said to Simon, his brother, Choose to thee (some) men, and go, and deliver thy brethren in Galilee; I forsooth and my brother Jonathan, shall go into Gilead.
1ST MACCABEES 5:18  And (so) he left Joseph, son of Zechariah, and Azariah, dukes of the people, with the residue host in Judea to keeping (it), (or to guard it);
1ST MACCABEES 5:19  and [he] commanded to them, and said, Be ye sovereigns to this people, and do not ye smite battle against (the) heathen men, till we (re)turn again.
1ST MACCABEES 5:20  And men were given to Simon three thousands, for to go into Galilee; to Judas soothly eight thousand, into Gilead.
1ST MACCABEES 5:21  And Simon went into Galilee, and joined many battles with (the) heathen men. And (the) heathen men were all-broken from his face,
1ST MACCABEES 5:22  and he pursued them till to the gate of Ptolemais. And there fell down of (the) heathen men almost three thousand of men; and he took the spoils of them.
1ST MACCABEES 5:23  And he took them that were in Galilee, and in Arbattis, with (their) wives, and (their) children, and all things that were to them; and brought (them) into Judea with great gladness.
1ST MACCABEES 5:24  And Judas Maccabeus, and Jonathan, and his brethren passed (over the) Jordan, and went forth the way of three days into (the) desert.
1ST MACCABEES 5:25  And Nabathites or the Nabateans came against them, and received them peaceably, and told to them all things that befell to their brethren in Gilead;
1ST MACCABEES 5:26  and that many of them were taken [or caught] in Bozrah, and Bosor, and in Alema, and in Casphor, and Maked, and Carnaim; all these were strong cities and great.
1ST MACCABEES 5:27  But and in other cities of Gilead they be holden caught. And on the mor-row they ordained for to move the host to those cities, and for to take (them), and (to) do away them in one day.
1ST MACCABEES 5:28  And Judas turned, and his host, the way into (the) desert of Bozrah suddenly; and [he] occupied the city, and slew each male by the sharpness of (the) sword, and took all the spoils of them, and burnt it with fire.
1ST MACCABEES 5:29  And they rose thence in (the) night, and went unto the strengthening.
1ST MACCABEES 5:30  And it was made in (the) springing of (the) day, when they raised (up) their eyes, and lo! much people, of whom was no number, bearing ladders and engines, for to take the strengthening (or the stronghold), and overcome them.
1ST MACCABEES 5:31  And Judas saw, that battle began, and cry of battle ascended into heaven, as [a] trump, and great cry of [a] city.
1ST MACCABEES 5:32  And he said to his host, Fight ye today for your brethren.
1ST MACCABEES 5:33  And he came, and three orders after them [or And he came in three orders after them], and they cried with trumps, and cried in prayer.
1ST MACCABEES 5:34  And (the) hosts of Timothy (or of Timotheus) knew, that it was Macca-beus, and they fled from his face. And they have smitten them with (a) great wound; and there fell down of them in that day almost eight thousand of men.
1ST MACCABEES 5:35  And Judas turned away into Miz-peh; and [he] overcame (it), and took it, and slew each male thereof, and took (the) spoils of it, and burnt it with fire.
1ST MACCABEES 5:36  From thence he went, and took Casphor, and Maked, and Bosor, and other cities of Gilead.
1ST MACCABEES 5:37  Forsooth after these words, Timothy gathered another host, and putted tents against Raphon, over the stream.
1ST MACCABEES 5:38  And Judas sent for to behold the host, and they told again to him, and said, That all (the) heathen men that be in our compass, full much host, came together to him.
1ST MACCABEES 5:39  And they hired Arabians into help to (or for) them, and they have set (up their) tents over the stream, and be ready for to come to thee into battle. And Judas went against (or towards) them.
1ST MACCABEES 5:40  And Timothy said to the princes of his host, When Judas nigheth, and his host, to the stream of water, if he passeth former (or over first) to us, we shall not be able to abide him, for he mighty shall be able to be against us.
1ST MACCABEES 5:41  Soothly if he dreadeth for to pass (over), and setteth (up his) tents beyond the flood (or river), pass we over to them, and we shall be able to be against him.
1ST MACCABEES 5:42  Forsooth as Judas nighed to the stream of water, he ordained scribes, either writers, of the people, beside the stream, and commanded to them, and said, Leave ye none of (the) men, but come all into (the) battle.
1ST MACCABEES 5:43  And he the former (or first) passed over to them, and all the people after him. And all these heathen men were all-broken from the face of them, and they casted away their arms; and they fled to the temple, that was at Carnaim.
1ST MACCABEES 5:44  And Judas occupied that city, and burnt the temple with fire, and all that were in it; and Carnaim was oppress-ed, and might not abide [or sustain] against the face of Judas.
1ST MACCABEES 5:45  And Judas gathered all Israelites that were in Gilead, from the least to the most, and wives of them, and children, and a full great host, that they should come into the land of Judea.
1ST MACCABEES 5:46  And they came till to Ephron, and this great city, put in the entry, was full strong; and there was not for to bow away from it, in (the) right half or left, but the way was through the middle.
1ST MACCABEES 5:47  And they that were in the city closed in them(selves), and stopped (up) the gates with stones.
1ST MACCABEES 5:48  And Judas sent to them with peace-able words, and said, Pass we by your land, for to go into our land, and no man shall annoy (or shall harm) you, only on feet we shall go. And they would not open to them.
1ST MACCABEES 5:49  And Judas commanded for to preach in (the) tents, either (the) host, that each man should apply, (or encamp at), in what place he was.
1ST MACCABEES 5:50  And (the) men of virtue applied them (or And the fighting men encamp-ed themselves), and he fought against that city all day and all night, and the city was betaken in(to) his hand(s).
1ST MACCABEES 5:51  And they slew each male by the sharpness of (the) sword, and drew up by the roots it [or drew it up by the roots], and took the spoils thereof, and passed by all the city on the slain men.
1ST MACCABEES 5:52  And they passed over (the) Jordan, in the great field against the face of (or opposite) Bethshan.
1ST MACCABEES 5:53  And Judas was gathering the last men, and admonished the people by all the way, till they came into the land of Judea.
1ST MACCABEES 5:54  And they went up into the hill of Zion with gladness and joy, and offered burnt sacrifices, that no man of them fell down, or was dead, till they (re)turned again in peace.
1ST MACCABEES 5:55  And in the days in which Judas was, and Jonathan, in the land of Gilead, and Simon, his brother, in Galilee, against the face of Ptolemais,
1ST MACCABEES 5:56  Joseph, son of Zechariah, heard, and Azariah, prince of virtue (or the leaders of the hosts), the things done well, and (the) battles that were made.
1ST MACCABEES 5:57  And he said, Make we also a name to us, and go we for to fight against heathen men, that be in our compass.
1ST MACCABEES 5:58  And he commanded to these that were in his host, and they went forth to Jamnia.
1ST MACCABEES 5:59  And Gorgias went out of the city, and his men, against them, into fight.
1ST MACCABEES 5:60  And Joseph and Azariah were driven into, or unto, the ends of Judea; and there fell down in that day of the people of Israel, men to two thousands.
1ST MACCABEES 5:61  And a great wound was made in the people; for they heard not Judas and his brethren, and guessed them-(selves) to do (something) strongly.
1ST MACCABEES 5:62  Forsooth they were not of (or from) the seed of those men, by which health (or deliverance) was made in Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 5:63  And (the) men of Juda(s) were magnified greatly in the sight of all Israel (or And Judas and his men were greatly magnified in the sight of all Israel), and of all (the) heathen men, where the name of them was heard.
1ST MACCABEES 5:64  And they came together, crying to them prosperity, either praisings.
1ST MACCABEES 5:65  And Judas went out, and his brethren, and overcame the sons of Esau, in the land that is at the south; and he smote Hebron, and (the) villages thereof, and destroyed the wardings, or the walls, thereof, and burnt with fire (the) towers thereof in compass.
1ST MACCABEES 5:66  And he moved (the) tents, for to go into the land of (the) aliens; and went through Samaria.
1ST MACCABEES 5:67  In that day (some) priests fell down in battle, while they would (or desired to) do strongly, while (or for) without counsel they went out into battle.
1ST MACCABEES 5:68  And Judas bowed away (or turned) into Azotus, in the land of (the) aliens, and destroyed (the) altars of them, and burnt in fire the spoils of their gods, and took (the) preys of (the) cities; and (then)(re)turned again into the land of Judea.
1ST MACCABEES 6:1  And king Antiochus walked through the high countries, and heard that a city, Elymais, was in Persia, the noblest and (most) plenteous in silver and gold;
1ST MACCABEES 6:2  and a temple in it was full rich (or and in it was a very rich temple), and there were golden veils, and haber-geons, and shields, which Alexander (the son) of Philip, king of Macedonia, left, that reigned the first in Greece.
1ST MACCABEES 6:3  And he came, and sought for to take the city, and (to) rob it; and he might not, for the word was known to them that were in the city.
1ST MACCABEES 6:4  And they rised up into battle, and he flew from thence, and went away with great heaviness, and (re)turned again to Babylon.
1ST MACCABEES 6:5  And there came one, that told to him in Persia, that the hosts that were in the land of Judea were driven (away),
1ST MACCABEES 6:6  and that Lysias went with strong virtue in (or with the great power of) the first, or (the) best, men, and was driven (away) from the face of (the) Jews, and (that) they waxed strong in arms, and strengths (or strongholds), and many preys, which they took of tents, either (the) hosts, that they slew;
1ST MACCABEES 6:7  and that they destroyed the abomination, which he builded on the altar that was in Jerusalem, and they (en)compassed with high walls the hallowing (or the Temple), as before, but and Bethsura, his city.
1ST MACCABEES 6:8  And it was done, as the king heard these words, he dreaded, and was moved greatly, and fell down into a bed, and fell into a great sickness for heaviness, for it was not done as he thought.
1ST MACCABEES 6:9  And he was there many days, for great heaviness was renewed in him, and he deemed himself for to die.
1ST MACCABEES 6:10  And he called all his friends, and said to them, Sleep passed away from mine eyes, and I failed in heart, and fell down for busyness [or I fell down in heart for busyness];
1ST MACCABEES 6:11  and I said in mine heart, Into how great tribulation became I [or came I], and into what waves of heaviness in which I am now, that was merry, and beloved in my power?
1ST MACCABEES 6:12  Now forsooth I bethink on the evils that I did to Jerusalem, from whence and I took all (the) golden spoils, and silvern, that were therein; and I sent without cause, that men dwelling in Judea to be done away.
1ST MACCABEES 6:13  Therefore I knew that these evils found me therefore, and lo! I perish by great heaviness in an alien land.
1ST MACCABEES 6:14  And he called (for) Philip, one of his friends, and made him sovereign on all his realm;
1ST MACCABEES 6:15  and gave to him a diadem, and his stole, and ring, for to lead Antiochus, his son, and nourish him (up), (or to nurse him), and that he should reign.
1ST MACCABEES 6:16  And king Antiochus died there, in the hundred and nine and fortieth year.
1ST MACCABEES 6:17  And Lysias knew, that the king was dead, and [he] ordained Antiochus, the son of him, for to reign, whom he nourished (or nursed, when he was) young; and [he] called his name Eupator.
1ST MACCABEES 6:18  And they that were in the high tower, closed (up)(al)together Israel in compass of holy things (or the Temple), and sought to them evils evermore, to (the) strengthening of heathen men.
1ST MACCABEES 6:19  And Judas thought for to destroy them, and called together all the people, for to besiege them.
1ST MACCABEES 6:20  And they came together, and besieged them, in the hundred and fiftieth year; and they made arblasts (or arrow-blasters), that is, an instrument for to cast shafts, and stones, and engines.
1ST MACCABEES 6:21  And some of them that were besieged, went out; and some unfaithful [or unpious] men of Israel joined themselves to them,
1ST MACCABEES 6:22  and went to the king, and said, How long doest thou not doom, and avengest not our brethren?
1ST MACCABEES 6:23  And we deemed for to serve thy father, and for to walk in his behests, and obey to his commandments.
1ST MACCABEES 6:24  And the sons of our people aliened (or alienated) them(selves) from us for this thing; and whichever (or whom-ever) were found of us, were slain, and our heritages were ravished away.
1ST MACCABEES 6:25  And not only to us they stretched out the hand, but and into all our coasts.
1ST MACCABEES 6:26  And lo! they applied today to (or encamped at) the high tower in Jerusalem, for to occupy it, and they strengthened a strengthening (or stronghold) in Bethsura.
1ST MACCABEES 6:27  And if thou shalt not before come them more swiftly, they shall do greater things than these, and thou shalt not be able to wield them.
1ST MACCABEES 6:28  And the king was wroth, as he heard this thing, and called together all his friends, and princes of his host, and them that were over (the) horsemen;
1ST MACCABEES 6:29  but also an hired host from other realms, and (the) isles, and (the) coasts came to him.
1ST MACCABEES 6:30  And the number of his host was an hundred thousand of footmen, and twenty thousand of horsemen, and two and thirty elephants taught to battle.
1ST MACCABEES 6:31  And they came by Idumea (or through Edom), and they applied to (or encamped at) Bethsura, and fought (for) many days; and they made en-gines, and they went out, and burnt them in (or with) fire, and fought manly.
1ST MACCABEES 6:32  And Judas went from the high tower, and moved tents to Bethzech-ariah, against (the) tents of the king.
1ST MACCABEES 6:33  And the king rose before the light, and stirred the host into fierceness, against (or towards) the way of Beth-zechariah; and the hosts made ready them(selves)(al)together into (or for) battle, and sang in (or with) trumps.
1ST MACCABEES 6:34  And to (the) elephants they showed (the) blood of grape(s), and (of) morus, or (of) mulberry trees, for to whet them into battle.
1ST MACCABEES 6:35  And they parted the beasts by (or among the) legions; and to each elephant a thousand men stood nigh in habergeons chained, or mailed, together, and brazen helmets in (or on) their heads, and five hundred horse-men chosen [or chosen horsemen] were ordained to (or for) each beast.
1ST MACCABEES 6:36  These were there before the time, wherever the beast was; and whither ever it went, they went, and departed not therefrom.
1ST MACCABEES 6:37  But and firm towers of tree (or of wood)were on them, defending by all the beasts, and on them were engines, and on each by themselves men of virtue (or strong men) two and thirty, which fought from above, and within was the master of the beast.
1ST MACCABEES 6:38  And he ordained the residue multitude of (the) horsemen on this half and (on) that half, into two parts, for to move (al)together the host with (the) trumps, and for to constrain the men made thick in their legions.
1ST MACCABEES 6:39  And as the sun shined into (or onto) the golden shields, and brazen, the hills shined again of (or from) them, and shined again, as lamps of fire.
1ST MACCABEES 6:40  And a part of the king’s host was parted by (or to the) high hills, and other(s) by (or to the) low places; and they went warily, and ordinately.
1ST MACCABEES 6:41  And all men dwelling in the land were moved (al)together of (or by) the voice of (the) multitude of them, and (the) in-going of (the) company, and (the) hurtling together of (the) armours; for the host was full great and strong.
1ST MACCABEES 6:42  And Judas and his host nighed into battle; and there fell down of the king’s host six hundred men.
1ST MACCABEES 6:43  And Eleazar, the son of Avaran, saw one of the beasts habergeoned with habergeons of the king, and it was high standing over (the) other beasts; and it was seen to him (or it seemed to him), that the king was on it.
1ST MACCABEES 6:44  And he gave himself for to deliver his people, (and) for to get to him(self) a name everlasting.
1ST MACCABEES 6:45  And he ran thereto hardily, into the middle of (the) legion, and killed on the right half and on the left; and they fell down from him hither and thither.
1ST MACCABEES 6:46  And he went under the feet of the elephant, and under-putted himself thereto, and slew it; and it fell down into (or onto the) earth on him, and he was dead there.
1ST MACCABEES 6:47  And they saw the virtue (or the strength) of the king, and the fierceness of his host, and turned away them-selves from them.
1ST MACCABEES 6:48  Forsooth (the) tents (or the host) of the king went up against them, into Jerusalem; and (the) tents of the king applied to Judea, and to the hill of Zion (or the king pitched his tents before or towards Judea, and mount Zion);
1ST MACCABEES 6:49  and he made peace with these that were in Bethsura. And they went out of the city, for foods were not to them closed (up)(al)together there, for the sabbaths of (the) earth were.
1ST MACCABEES 6:50  And the king took Bethsura, and ordained there (a) keeping, for to keep it.
1ST MACCABEES 6:51  And he turned the tents to the place of hallowing (for) many days (or And he turned the host, to besiege the Temple for many days); and ordained there arblasts (or arrow-blasters), and engines, and darts, or castings, of fire, and torments for to cast stones and darts, and scorpions for to shoot arrows, and slings.
1ST MACCABEES 6:52  Forsooth and they made engines against the engines of them, and [they] fought (for) many days.
1ST MACCABEES 6:53  Forsooth meats were not in the city, for that it was the seventh year; and they that (were) left of (the) heathen men in Judea, had wasted the reliefs (or had eaten the remnants) of those things that were kept.
1ST MACCABEES 6:54  And few men left in holy things (or And there were only a few men left in the Temple), for hunger had taken them; and they were scattered, each man into his (own) place.
1ST MACCABEES 6:55  And Lysias heard, that Philip, whom king Antiochus ordained, when he lived yet, that he should nourish (up) Antiochus, his son, (so) that he should reign,
1ST MACCABEES 6:56  (re)turned again from Persia and Media, and the host that went with him. And that he seeketh for to take the causes of the realm,
1ST MACCABEES 6:57  Lysias hast(en)ed for to go, and said to the king, and (the) dukes of the host, We fail each day, and little meat (or food) is (left) to (or for) us, and the place which we besiege, is strong, and it falleth to us for to ordain of the realm.
1ST MACCABEES 6:58  Therefore now give we right hands to these men, and make we peace with them, and with all the folk of them;
1ST MACCABEES 6:59  and ordain we to them, (so) that they go in lawful things as before; for why for the lawful things of them which we despised, they be wroth, and have done all these things.
1ST MACCABEES 6:60  And the word pleased in the sight of the king, and of (the) princes; and he sent to them for to make peace, and they received it.
1ST MACCABEES 6:61  And the king swore to them, and (the) princes; and they went out of the strengthening (or the stronghold).
1ST MACCABEES 6:62  And the king entered into the mount Zion, and he saw the strength-ening of the place; and he brake full soon the oath that he swore, and commanded for to destroy the wall in compass.
1ST MACCABEES 6:63  And he departed away hastily, and (re)turned again to Antioch, and found Philip reigning in the city; and he fought against him, and occupied the city by strength.
1ST MACCABEES 7:1  In the hundred year and one and fifty, Demetrius, son of Seleucus, went out from the city of Rome, and went up with a few men into a city nigh the sea, and reigned there.
1ST MACCABEES 7:2  And it was done, as he entered into the house of the realm of his fathers, the host caught Antiochus, and Lysias, for to bring them to him.
1ST MACCABEES 7:3  And the thing was known to him, and he said, Do not ye show to me the face(s) of them.
1ST MACCABEES 7:4  And the host slew them. And Demetrius sat on the seat of his realm;
1ST MACCABEES 7:5  and wicked men and unfaithful of Israel came to him, and Alcimus, duke of them, that would be made (the high) priest;
1ST MACCABEES 7:6  and accused the people with the king, and said, Judas and his brethren lost (all) thy friends, and diversely lost (or drove)[or scattered] us from our land.
1ST MACCABEES 7:7  Now therefore send thou a man, to whom thou believest, that he go, and see all the destroying that he hath done to us, and to (the) countries of the king; and (then) he punish all (the) friends of him, and (the) helpers of them.
1ST MACCABEES 7:8  And the king chose of his friends Bacchides, that was lord over the great flood (or beyond the Euphrates River) in the realm, and true to the king,
1ST MACCABEES 7:9  and [he] sent him, for to see the destroying that Judas did; and he ordained unfaithful Alcimus into (the) priesthood, and bade him (to) do vengeance on the sons of Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 7:10  And they rose, and came with (a) great host into the land of Judea; and they sent messengers, and spake to Judas and his brethren, with peace-able words in guile.
1ST MACCABEES 7:11  And they gave not attention to their words; for they saw, that they came with (a) great host.
1ST MACCABEES 7:12  And the congregation of scribes came together to Alcimus and Bacchides, for to ask (for) those things that be just;
1ST MACCABEES 7:13  and the first (were the) Hasideans, that were among the sons of Israel, and they asked of them (for) peace.
1ST MACCABEES 7:14  For they said, A man, (a) priest of the seed of Aaron, cometh, (and) he shall not deceive us.
1ST MACCABEES 7:15  And he spake with them peace-able words, and swore to them, and said, We shall not bring into you evils, neither to your friends.
1ST MACCABEES 7:16  And they believed to him. And (then) he caught of them sixty men, and slew them in one day, by [or after] the word that is written,
1ST MACCABEES 7:17  They shed out the fleshes of thy saints, and (the) blood of them in compass of Jerusalem, and there was not that buried (them).
1ST MACCABEES 7:18  And dread and trembling fell into all the people, for they said, There is not truth and doom in them; for they have broken the statute, or ordinance, and the oath that they swore.
1ST MACCABEES 7:19  And Bacchides moved tents from Jerusalem, and applied into (or pitched at) Bethzaith; and sent (for), and caught many of them that fled from him; and he killed some of the people, and casted (them) into a great pit.
1ST MACCABEES 7:20  And he betook the country to Alcimus, and left with him help, into (the) helping of him. And Bacchides went to the king,
1ST MACCABEES 7:21  and Alcimus did enough, for the princehood of his priesthood.
1ST MACCABEES 7:22  And all came together to him, which disturbed, or troubled, their people, and wielded the land of Judea; and [they] did great vengeance in Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 7:23  And Judas saw all the evils, that Alcimus did, and they that were with him, to the sons of Israel, much more than (the) heathen men.
1ST MACCABEES 7:24  And he went out into all the coasts of Judea in compass, and did venge-ance on men forsakers, and they ceased for to go out further into the country.
1ST MACCABEES 7:25  Forsooth Alcimus saw, that Judas had (the) victory, and they that were with him; and he knew that he may not (or he was not able to) abide them, and he went again to the king, and accused them in (or of) many sins.
1ST MACCABEES 7:26  And the king sent Nicanor, one of his nobler princes, that was haunting enmities against Israel, and command-ed him for to destroy the people.
1ST MACCABEES 7:27  And Nicanor came into Jerusalem, with (a) great host, and he sent to Judas and his brethren with guile, by peaceable words, saying,
1ST MACCABEES 7:28  Fight be not betwixt me and you; I shall come with (a) few men, for to see your faces with peace.
1ST MACCABEES 7:29  And he came to Judas, and they greeted them(selves) together peace-ably; and (the) enemies were ready for to ravish (or to kidnap) Judas.
1ST MACCABEES 7:30  And the word was known to Judas, that with guile he came to him; and he was afeared of him, and he would no more see his face.
1ST MACCABEES 7:31  And Nicanor knew, that his coun-sel was known, and he went out against Judas into fight, beside Capharsalama.
1ST MACCABEES 7:32  And there fell down of Nicanor’s host almost five thousand men, and they fled into the city of David.
1ST MACCABEES 7:33  And after these words Nicanor went up into the hill of Zion, and there went out of (the Temple some) priests of the people, for to greet him in peace, and for to show to him (the) burnt sacri-fices, that were offered for the king.
1ST MACCABEES 7:34  And he scorned and despised them, and defouled (them), and spake proudly,
1ST MACCABEES 7:35  and swore with wrath, saying, If Judas shall not be taken, and his host, into mine hands, anon when I shall (re)turn again in peace, I shall burn (down) this house. And he went out with great wrath.
1ST MACCABEES 7:36  And (the) priests entered, and stood before the face of the altar and (the) temple, and weeping, they said,
1ST MACCABEES 7:37  Thou, Lord, hast chosen this house, for to call to help thy name in it, that it should be an house of prayer and beseeching to (or for) thy people;
1ST MACCABEES 7:38  do thou vengeance in (or to) this man, and his host, and fall they by (the) sword; have mind on their blasphemies, and give not to them that they abide (any longer).
1ST MACCABEES 7:39  And Nicanor went out from Jeru-salem, and applied tents to Bethhoron (or and pitched his tents in Bethhoron); and the host of Syria came to him.
1ST MACCABEES 7:40  And Judas applied in (or pitched at) Adasa, with three thousand men. And Judas prayed, and said,
1ST MACCABEES 7:41  Lord, an angel went out, and smote an hundred thousand fourscore and five thousands of them, that were sent from king Sennacherib, for they blasphemed thee;
1ST MACCABEES 7:42  so all-break this host in our sight today, and (so that) other men know, that he spake evil on thine holy things (or against thy Temple); and deem thou him by [or after] the malice of him.
1ST MACCABEES 7:43  And the hosts joined battle in the thirteenth day of the month Adar, that is, February-March; and the tents, (or the host), of Nicanor were all-broken, and he fell down first in (the) battle.
1ST MACCABEES 7:44  Soothly as his host saw, that Nicanor fell down, they casted away their arms, (or weapons), and fled.
1ST MACCABEES 7:45  And they pursued them the way of one day, from Adasa till men come into Gazara; and they sung in (or with) trumps after them with signifyings.
1ST MACCABEES 7:46  And they went out of all (the) castles, (or towns) of Judea in compass, and winnowed them with horns, and again they were converted (or turned back) to them; and all falled [or fell] by (the) sword, and there was left of them not one.
1ST MACCABEES 7:47  And they took the spoils of them [in] to prey; and they girded [or cutted] off the head of Nicanor, and his right hand which he stretched forth (so) proudly, and they brought, and hang-ed (them up) against Jerusalem.
1ST MACCABEES 7:48  And the people was glad greatly, and they did that day in great gladness;
1ST MACCABEES 7:49  and ordained this day for to be done in all years, in the thirteenth day of the month Adar.
1ST MACCABEES 7:50  And the land of Judea was still (for) a few days.
1ST MACCABEES 8:1  And Judas (had) heard the name (or the fame) of (the) Romans, that they be mighty in strengths, and accord to all things that be asked of them; and whoever went to them, they ordained with them friendships;
1ST MACCABEES 8:2  and that they be mighty in strengths. And they heard (of the) battles of them, and good virtues, that they did in Galatia, for they wielded them, and led them under tribute;
1ST MACCABEES 8:3  and how many things they did in the country of Spain, and that they brought into power metals of silver and gold that be there;
1ST MACCABEES 8:4  and (that) they wielded each place with their counsel, and (with) patience, or wisdom, places that were full far from them; and they all-brake kings that came on them from the utmost places of (the) earth, and they smited them with (a) great wound; forsooth others give to them tribute by all years.
1ST MACCABEES 8:5  And they all-brake in battle Philip, and Perseus, kings [or king] of Kittim, and others that bare arms (or weapons) against them, and wielded them.
1ST MACCABEES 8:6  And they wielded Antiochus, the great king of Asia, that gave battle to them, and had an hundred and twenty elephants, and multitude of horsemen, and chariots, and full great host all-broken of (or by) them;
1ST MACCABEES 8:7  and that they took him quick (or captured him alive), and ordained to him, that he should give great tribute, and they that reigned after him; and that he should give pledges and ordinance,
1ST MACCABEES 8:8  in the country of India; and they putted out men of Media, and of Lydia, from the best countries of them, and they gave those countries taken of (or from) them to king Eumenes;
1ST MACCABEES 8:9  and that they that were with (the) Greeks, would go, and take away them;
1ST MACCABEES 8:10  and the word was known to these Romans, and they sent to them one duke, and they fought against them; and many of them fell, and they led their wives captives, and sons, and robbed them; and wielded the land of them, and destroyed the walls of them, and brought them into servage (or into servitude), till into this day.
1ST MACCABEES 8:11  And they destroyed other realms and isles, that sometime against-stood them, and brought [them] into (or under their) power.
1ST MACCABEES 8:12  Forsooth with their friends, and (they) that had rest in them, they kept friendship, and they wielded realms that were next (or were near), and that were far; for whoever heard the name of them, dreaded them.
1ST MACCABEES 8:13  For they reigned, to whom they would be in help for to reign; forsooth which they would, they disturbed (or displaced) from (their) realm; and they were greatly enhanced (or exalted).
1ST MACCABEES 8:14  (Yet) In all these Romans, no man bare (a) diadem, neither was clothed in purple, for to be magnified therein.
1ST MACCABEES 8:15  And [for] they made to (or for) them(selves) a court, and each day they counselled three hundred and twenty, doing counsel evermore of (the) multitude, (so) that they do what things be worthy.
1ST MACCABEES 8:16  And they betake to one man their mastery, either chief governance, by each year, for to be lord of all their land; and all obeish (or obey) to one, and envy is not, neither wrath among them.
1ST MACCABEES 8:17  And Judas chose Eupolemus, the son of John, son of Accos, and Jason, the son of Eleazar, and sent them to Rome, for to ordain with them friend-ship and fellowship;
1ST MACCABEES 8:18  and (so) that they should take away from them the yoke of (the) Greeks, for they saw that they oppressed the realm of Israel into servage (or into servitude).
1ST MACCABEES 8:19  And they went to Rome, a full great way, and they entered into the court, and said,
1ST MACCABEES 8:20  Judas Maccabeus, and his brethren, and the people of (the) Jews, sent us to you, for to ordain with you fellow-ship and peace, and for to write together us (as) your fellows and friends.
1ST MACCABEES 8:21  And the word pleased in the sight of them.
1ST MACCABEES 8:22  And this is the again-writing, which they again-writed in brazen tables (or wrote upon brass or bronze tablets), and sent into Jerusalem, (so) that it were there a memorial, either a thing of mind, of peace and fellowship.
1ST MACCABEES 8:23  Be it well to (the) Romans, and to the folk of (the) Jews, in the sea and (the) land, without end; and sword and enemy be far from them.
1ST MACCABEES 8:24  That if battle befall to (the) Romans before, [or former], (or first), either to all fellows of them in all the lordship of them,
1ST MACCABEES 8:25  the folk of (the) Jews shall bear help, as time asketh, with (their) full heart;
1ST MACCABEES 8:26  and the Romans shall not give, neither privily minister to the Jews fighting, wheat, armours, (or arms, or weapons), money, ships, as it pleased to (the) Romans; and they shall keep the commandments of them, and take nothing of (or from) them.
1ST MACCABEES 8:27  Forsooth in like manner, and if battle falleth before (or first) to the folk of (the) Jews, (the) Romans shall help of (or with)(a)[good] heart, as time suffereth (or alloweth) them;
1ST MACCABEES 8:28  and to (the)Romans helping, wheat shall not be given, neither armours, (nor arms, or weapons), money, neither ships, as it pleased to (the) Romans; and they shall keep the command-ments of them without guile.
1ST MACCABEES 8:29  By [or After] these words the Romans ordained to the people of (the) Jews,
1ST MACCABEES 8:30  That if after these words, these either they will put anything to, either do away, they shall do of (or by) their common assent; and whatever things they shall put to, either do away, they shall be steadfast.
1ST MACCABEES 8:31  But also of (the) evils which king Demetrius hath done against them, we have written to him, and we said Why hast thou grieved thy yoke on our friends and fellows, the Jews?
1ST MACCABEES 8:32  Therefore if again they shall come to us against thee, we shall do doom to them, and shall fight with thee by land and (by) sea.
1ST MACCABEES 9:1  In the meantime, where (or when) Demetrius heard that Nicanor fell, and his host, in battle, he putted to again for to send Bacchides and Alcimus into Judea, and the right half of the battle array with them.
1ST MACCABEES 9:2  And they went the way that leadeth into Gilgal, and they setted (up their) tents in Mesaloth, that is in Arbela; and they occupied it, and slew many persons of men.
1ST MACCABEES 9:3  In the first month of the hundred and two and fifty year, they applied the host to Jerusalem (or they pitched their tents near Jerusalem).
1ST MACCABEES 9:4  And twenty thousand of men, and two thousand of horsemen, have risen, and went into Berea.
1ST MACCABEES 9:5  And Judas setted (up his) tents in Eleasa, and three thousand men chosen [or chosen men] with him.
1ST MACCABEES 9:6  And they saw the multitude of the host, that they be many, and they dreaded greatly; and many withdrew them(selves) from (the) tents (or out of the host), and there (were) left not of them no but eight hundred men.
1ST MACCABEES 9:7  And Judas saw that his host fled away, and (that the) battle constrained him, and he was broken (al)together in heart, for he had not time to gather them, and he was discomforted.
1ST MACCABEES 9:8  And he said to these that were residue, Rise we, and go we to our adversaries, if we shall be able to fight against them.
1ST MACCABEES 9:9  And they turned away (from) him, and said, We shall not be able to, but deliver we [now] our own lives, and (re)turn again we to our brethren, and then we shall fight against them; forsooth we be few.
1ST MACCABEES 9:10  And Judas said, Far be it for to do this thing, that we flee from them; and if our time hath nighed, die we in virtue (or bravely) for our brethren, and give we not crime to our glory.
1ST MACCABEES 9:11  And the host (of Bacchides) moved from (their) tents, and they stood against them. And (the) horsemen were parted into two parts, and slingers and archers went before the host, and the first men of battle (were) all the mighty (men).
1ST MACCABEES 9:12  Forsooth Bacchides was in the right horn, or battle array. And the legion of two parts came nigh, and cried with (the) trumps.
1ST MACCABEES 9:13  Forsooth and these that were on [or of] the part of Judas, cried also, and the earth was moved (al)together of (or by) the voice (or the noise) of (the) hosts, and (the) battle was joined from the morrowtide till to eventide.
1ST MACCABEES 9:14  And Judas saw, that the part of Bacchides’ host was firmer in (or on) the right half, and all (the) steadfast in heart came together with him.
1ST MACCABEES 9:15  And the right part was all-broken of (or by) them; and he pursued them unto the hill of Azotus.
1ST MACCABEES 9:16  And they that were in the left horn, or battle array, saw, that the right horn, or battle array, was all-broken, and they pursued (or followed) at the back after Judas, and them that were with him.
1ST MACCABEES 9:17  And the battle was made grievous, and there fell many wounded of these and of them.
1ST MACCABEES 9:18  And Judas fell, and the others fled.
1ST MACCABEES 9:19  And Jonathan and Simon took their brother Judas, and buried him in the sepulchre of his fathers, in the city of Modin.
1ST MACCABEES 9:20  And all Israel bewept him with great wailing, and mourned (for) many days, and said,
1ST MACCABEES 9:21  How fell the mighty (man), that made Israel safe (or who saved Israel).
1ST MACCABEES 9:22  And other words of (the) battles of Judas, and of (the) virtues that he did, and of his greatnesses, be not written (here); for those [or they] were full many.
1ST MACCABEES 9:23  And it was done, after the death of Judas, all wicked men in all the coasts of Israel rose out (or rose up), and all that wrought wickedness came forth.
1ST MACCABEES 9:24  In those days full great hunger was made, and all the country of them betook themselves to Bacchides with them.
1ST MACCABEES 9:25  And Bacchides chose unpious men, and ordained them lords of the country.
1ST MACCABEES 9:26  And they asked out (or about), and sought the friends of Judas, and brought them to Bacchides; and he avenged on them, and scorned (them).
1ST MACCABEES 9:27  And great tribulation was made in Israel, what manner was not from the day in which a prophet was not seen in Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 9:28  And all the friends of Judas were gathered, and said to Jonathan,
1ST MACCABEES 9:29  Since thy brother Judas is dead, there is no man like him, that shall go out against (our) enemies, Bacchides and them that be (the) enemies of our folk.
1ST MACCABEES 9:30  Therefore now we choose thee today for to be prince and duke to us for him, for to fight our battle(s).
1ST MACCABEES 9:31  And (so) Jonathan received in that time the princehood, and rose (up) in the place of Judas, his brother.
1ST MACCABEES 9:32  And Bacchides knew (this), and sought for to slay him.
1ST MACCABEES 9:33  And Jonathan knew (this), and Simon, his brother, and all that were with him, and [they] fled into (the) desert of Tekoa, and sat together at the water of the lake Asphar.
1ST MACCABEES 9:34  And Bacchides knew (this), and in the day of sabbath he came, and all his host, over (the) Jordan.
1ST MACCABEES 9:35  And Jonathan sent his brother (John), (a) leader of that people, and prayed (the) Nabathites or Nabateans, his friends, that he should betake to them his apparel, that was plenteous.
1ST MACCABEES 9:36  And (the) sons of Jambri went out of Medaba, and caught John, and all (the) things that he had, and went away, having (or taking) those things.
1ST MACCABEES 9:37  After these words it was told again to Jonathan, and Simon, his brother, that the sons of Jambri make great wed-dings, and wed a wife of Nadabath, the daughter of one of the great princes of Canaan, with great pride and apparel.
1ST MACCABEES 9:38  And they bethought on the blood of John, their brother, and went up, and hid themselves under (the) cover-ing of the hill.
1ST MACCABEES 9:39  And they raised (up) their eyes, and saw, and lo! noise, and great apparel; and a spouse, or (the) husband, came forth, and his friends, and his brethren, against (or towards) them, with tympans, and musics, and many arms.
1ST MACCABEES 9:40  And they rose (up) to (or against) them from (the) ambushments, and slew them, and many wounded fell down, and the residues fled into the hill, and they took all the spoils of them;
1ST MACCABEES 9:41  and (the) weddings were converted into mourning, and voice (or the sound) of their musics into wailing.
1ST MACCABEES 9:42  And they avenged the vengeance of their brother’s blood, and [they](re)-turned again to the brink of (the) Jordan.
1ST MACCABEES 9:43  And Bacchides heard, and came in the day of sabbaths till to the utmost part of (the) Jordan, in great strength.
1ST MACCABEES 9:44  And Jonathan said to his (men), Rise we (up), and fight against our enemies; for it is not today as yesterday, and the third day ago.
1ST MACCABEES 9:45  For lo! (the) battle is even against (or before us); soothly the water of (the) Jordan is on this half and on that half, and rivers, and marshes, and forests [or wild woods], and there is no place of turning away (or aside).
1ST MACCABEES 9:46  Now therefore cry ye into heaven, (so) that ye be delivered from (the) hand of your enemies.
1ST MACCABEES 9:47  And (the) battle was joined. And Jonathan straightened out (or stretched forth) his hand, for to smite Bacchides, and he turned away from him behind.
1ST MACCABEES 9:48  And Jonathan skipped down, and they that were with him, into (the) Jordan, and swam over (the) Jordan to them.
1ST MACCABEES 9:49  And there fell of Bacchides part in that day a thousand men,
