1ST MACCABEES 9:50  and they, that is, Bacchides and his men, (re)turned again into Jerusalem; and (re)builded (the) strong cities in Judea, the strength (or the stronghold) that was in Jericho, and in Emmaus, and in Bethhoron, and Bethel, and Thamnatha, Pharathoni, and Taphon, with high walls, and gates, and locks.
1ST MACCABEES 9:51  And he setted keeping in them, (so) that they should haunt enmities in (or upon) Israel;
1ST MACCABEES 9:52  and he strengthened the city (of) Bethsura, and Gazara, and the high tower, and putted in them helps, and apparel of meats (or food).
1ST MACCABEES 9:53  And he took the sons of princes of the country in (or for) hostage(s), or pledges, and putted them in the high tower in Jerusalem, in keeping.
1ST MACCABEES 9:54  And in the hundred year and three and fifty [or fiftieth], in the second month, Alcimus commanded (that) the walls of the holy inner house for to be destroyed, and the works of (the) prophets for to be destroyed,
1ST MACCABEES 9:55  and he began for to destroy (them). In that time Alcimus was smitten, and the works of him were hindered. And his mouth was closed, and he was dissolved, either made feeble, by palsy, neither he might speak more a word, and command of (or to) his house.
1ST MACCABEES 9:56  And Alcimus was dead in that time, with great torment.
1ST MACCABEES 9:57  And Bacchides saw, that Alcimus was dead, and he (re)turned again to the king, and the land was still two years.
1ST MACCABEES 9:58  And all (the) wicked men thought, saying, Lo! Jonathan, and they that be with him, dwell in silence, and trust; now therefore bring we Bacchides, and he shall take them all in one night.
1ST MACCABEES 9:59  And they went forth, and gave counsel to him.
1ST MACCABEES 9:60  And he rose (up), for to come with much host. And he sent epistles privily to his fellows, that were in Judea, that they should catch Jonathan, and them that were with him; but they might not, for their counsel was known to them.
1ST MACCABEES 9:61  And Jonathan caught (those) of men of the country, that were princes of knighthood, fifty men, and slew them.
1ST MACCABEES 9:62  And Jonathan and Simon went, and they that were with him, into Bethbasi, that is in (the) desert, and (re)builded the destroyed things there-of, and made it strong.
1ST MACCABEES 9:63  And Bacchides knew (this), and gathered all his multitude, and announced to them that were of Judea.
1ST MACCABEES 9:64  And he came, and setted (up) tents above Bethbasi, and fought against it many days, and made engines (of war).
1ST MACCABEES 9:65  And Jonathan left Simon, his brother, in the city, and went out into the coun-try, and came with (a) number (of men);
1ST MACCABEES 9:66  and smote Odomera, and his brethren, and (the) sons of Phasiron, in the tabernacles of them (or tents),
1ST MACCABEES 9:67  and [he] began for to smite, and wax in virtues (or increase his forces). Simon soothly, and they that were with him, went out of the city, and burnt (up the) engines (of war).
1ST MACCABEES 9:68  And they fought against Bacchides, and he was all-broken of (or by) them; and they tormented him greatly, for his counsel and his assailing was void.
1ST MACCABEES 9:69  And he was wroth against wicked men, that gave counsel to him for to come into their country, and slew many of them; forsooth he thought with others for to go into his country.
1ST MACCABEES 9:70  And Jonathan knew, and sent legates to him, for to make peace with him, and to yield to him (the) prisoners.
1ST MACCABEES 9:71  And willfully he took (or accepted), and did by [or after] his words, and swore that he should not do to him any evil in all the days of his life.
1ST MACCABEES 9:72  And he yielded to him the captivity, that is, (the Jewish) prisoners, which he took by prey before (out) of the land of Judea. And he (re)turned, and went into his land, and putted no more for to come into his coasts.
1ST MACCABEES 9:73  And (the) sword ceased from Israel. And Jonathan dwelled in Michmash, and there Jonathan began for to deem the people, and he destroyed the un-faithful [or unpious] men (out) of Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 10:1  And in the hundred and sixtieth year Alexander, the son of Antiochus, went up, that is named noble (or who was surnamed Epiphanes), [or that is named noble, went up], and occupied Ptolemais; and they received him, and he reigned there.
1ST MACCABEES 10:2  And king Demetrius heard, and gathered an host full copious, and went out against him into battle.
1ST MACCABEES 10:3  And Demetrius sent [an] epistle to Jonathan with peaceable words, for to magnify him.
1ST MACCABEES 10:4  For he said, Before take we for to make peace with him, before that he make (an accord) with Alexander against us;
1ST MACCABEES 10:5  for he shall have mind of or on all (the) evils, that we have done against him, and against his brother(s), and against his folk.
1ST MACCABEES 10:6  And he gave to him power to gather (an) host, and for to make arms, and him for to be his fellow. And he commanded (that the) hostages, either (the) pledges, that were in the high tower, for to be given to him.
1ST MACCABEES 10:7  And Jonathan came into Jerusalem, and read (the) epistles (or the letter), in (the) hearing of all the people, and of them that were in the high tower.
1ST MACCABEES 10:8  And they dreaded with great dread, for they heard, that the king gave him power to gather an host.
1ST MACCABEES 10:9  And (the) hostages were betaken to Jonathan, and he yielded them (back) to their fathers and mothers.
1ST MACCABEES 10:10  And Jonathan dwelt in Jerusalem, and began for to build and renew the city.
1ST MACCABEES 10:11  And he said to men doing (the) works, that they should make up the walls, and the hill of Zion in compass, with square stones to (or for) strengthening; and they did so.
1ST MACCABEES 10:12  And (the) aliens fled, that were in the strengths (or in the strongholds), which Bacchides had builded;
1ST MACCABEES 10:13  and each man left his place, and went into his (own) land.
1ST MACCABEES 10:14  Only in Bethsura dwelt some of them, that forsook the law and the behests of God; for why this was to (or for) them the (place of) refuge.
1ST MACCABEES 10:15  And Alexander the king heard (the) promises, that Demetrius (had) promised to Jonathan, and they told to him (of) the battles and virtues which he did, and his brethren, and the travails which they travailed.
1ST MACCABEES 10:16  And he said, Whether we shall find any such man? And now make we him our friend and fellow.
1ST MACCABEES 10:17  And he wrote (an) epistle, and sent (it to him), by these words, saying,
1ST MACCABEES 10:18  King Alexander to Jonathan, brother, health.
1ST MACCABEES 10:19  We have heard of thee, that thou art a mighty man in strengths, and art able that thou be our friend.
1ST MACCABEES 10:20  And now we ordain thee today (to be the) highest priest of thy folk, and that thou be called (the) friend of the king. And he sent to him purple, and a golden crown, that thou feel with us what things be ours, and keep friendships to (or with) us.
1ST MACCABEES 10:21  And Jonathan clothed him(self) with an holy stole, in the seventh month, in the hundred and sixtieth year, in the solemn day of Scenopegia (or Feast of Tabernacles). And he gathered an host (or army), and made copious or plen-teous arms (or prepared many weapons).
1ST MACCABEES 10:22  And Demetrius heard these words, and was made full sorrowful, and said,
1ST MACCABEES 10:23  What have we done this thing, that Alexander before-occupied us, for to catch (the) friendship of (or with the) Jews, to his (own) strengthening?
1ST MACCABEES 10:24  And I shall write to him praying words, and (promise him) dignities, and gifts, (so) that he be with me in help.
1ST MACCABEES 10:25  And (so) he wrote to him by these words, King Demetrius to the folk of (the) Jews, health.
1ST MACCABEES 10:26  For ye kept to us covenant, and dwelt in our friendship, and went not to our enemies, we heard, and joyed.
1ST MACCABEES 10:27  And now last ye yet for to keep to us faith; and we shall (re)quite to you good things, for these things that ye did to (or for) us,
1ST MACCABEES 10:28  and we shall forgive to you many [givings of] rents, and we shall give gifts to you.
1ST MACCABEES 10:29  And now I assoil (or I absolve) you, and all (the) Jews, of tributes, and I forgive to you the prices of salt, and forgive crowns (or crown taxes),
1ST MACCABEES 10:30  and the third part of (the) seed; and I leave to you from this day and afterward, the half part of (the) fruit of the tree(s), that is of my portion, (so) that it be not taken of the land of Judea, and of (the) three cities that be added thereto, of Samaria and Galilee, from this day and into all time.
1ST MACCABEES 10:31  And (let) Jerusalem be holy, and free, with his (or its) coasts; and tithes and tributes be of it.
1ST MACCABEES 10:32  Also I forgive the power of the high tower, that is in Jerusalem; and I give it to the high or highest priest, that he ordain therein men, whichever he shall choose, that shall keep it.
1ST MACCABEES 10:33  And each person of (the) Jews, that is captive (out) of the land of Judea, in all my realm, I deliver free willfully, or without money, that all be absolved of their tributes, yea, of their beasts.
1ST MACCABEES 10:34  And all solemn days, and sabbaths, and new moons, and all days ordained, and three days before the solemn day, and three days after the solemn day, all these be days of immunity, or franchise, and of remission, to all (the) Jews that be in my realm.
1ST MACCABEES 10:35  And no man shall have power for to do anything, and move needs, or causes, against any of them in (or for) any cause.
1ST MACCABEES 10:36  And that there be written (in) of (the) Jews in the king’s host, (up) to thirty thousands of men; and plenties shall be given to them, as it behoov-eth to all (the) hosts of the king.
1ST MACCABEES 10:37  And of them shall be ordained, that be in the great strengths (or strongholds) of the king; of them shall be ordained over needs of the realm, that be done of faith, and (their) princes be of them; and walk they in their laws, as the king commanded in the land of Judea.
1ST MACCABEES 10:38  And (the) three cities, that be added to Judea of (or from) the country of Samaria, be areckoned, or deemed, with Judea; (so) that they be under one, and obey not to (any) other power, no but to the highest priest;
1ST MACCABEES 10:39  (As for) Ptolemais, and the coasts thereof, which I have given (as) a gift to holy men that be in Jerusalem, to needful costs of saints (or the Temple).
1ST MACCABEES 10:40  And I shall give in each year fifteen thousand of shekels of silver, of the king’s reasons, that pertain to me;
1ST MACCABEES 10:41  and all that is residue, which they that were over (the) needs yielded not in former years, from this time they shall give into the works of the house.
1ST MACCABEES 10:42  And over this, five thousand shekels of silver, which they took of reason of holy things by each year; and these things shall pertain to (the) priests, that use [or be set in] ministry.
1ST MACCABEES 10:43  And whoever shall flee to the temple that is in Jerusalem, and in all (the) coasts thereof, and be guilty to the king, in any cause, be dismissed, or released; and have they free all things, that be to them in my realm.
1ST MACCABEES 10:44  And to build, or restore, works of holy things (or the works of the Temple), costs, or expenses, shall be given (out) of the king’s reason, or rent, (or out of the king’s accounts),
1ST MACCABEES 10:45  and for to build out the walls of Jerusalem; and for to make (them) strong in compass, expenses shall be given (out) of the king’s reason, or rent, for to make out (the) walls in Judea.
1ST MACCABEES 10:46  As Jonathan and the people heard these words, they believed not to them, neither received them; for they had (in) mind of the great malice that he had done in Israel, and (that he) had troubled them greatly.
1ST MACCABEES 10:47  And it pleased (al)together to them in (or with) Alexander, for he was to them (the) prince of words of peace, and to him they bare help in all days.
1ST MACCABEES 10:48  And king Alexander gathered a great host, and moved (his) tents against Demetrius.
1ST MACCABEES 10:49  And the kings joined battle, and the host of Demetrius fled; and Alex-ander pursued him, and lay on them;
1ST MACCABEES 10:50  and the battle was full strong, till the sun went down, and Demetrius fell in that day.
1ST MACCABEES 10:51  And Alexander sent to Ptolemy, king of Egypt, legates by (or ambass-adors with) these words, and said,
1ST MACCABEES 10:52  For I came again into my realm, and sat in the seat of my fathers; and I have wielded princehood, and I have all-broken Demetrius, and have wield-ed our country;
1ST MACCABEES 10:53  and I have joined fight with him, and he and his hosts be all-fouled [or is broken (al)together] of (or by) us, and we sat in the seat of his realm.
1ST MACCABEES 10:54  And now ordain we together friendship, and give thy daughter (as) a wife to me, and I shall be thy daughter(’s) husband; and I shall give to thee gifts, and to her dignity.
1ST MACCABEES 10:55  And king Ptolemy answered, say-ing, Blessed be the day in which thou (re)turnedest again to the land of thy fathers, and hast sat in the seat (or on the throne) of the realm of them.
1ST MACCABEES 10:56  And now I shall do to thee which things thou hast written; but come thou against me to (or meet me in) Ptolemais, (so) that we see us together, and I promise to thee, as thou saidest.
1ST MACCABEES 10:57  And Ptolemy went out of Egypt, he and Cleopatra, his daughter; and he came to Ptolemais, in the hundred and two and sixtieth year.
1ST MACCABEES 10:58  And Alexander, the king, came to him; and he gave to him Cleopatra, his daughter, and made his weddings at Ptolemais, as kings in great glory (do).
1ST MACCABEES 10:59  And king Alexander wrote to Jonathan, that he should come against him (or should come to meet him).
1ST MACCABEES 10:60  And he went with glory to Ptolemais, and met there (the) two kings, and gave to them much silver, and gold, and gifts; and found grace in the sight of them.
1ST MACCABEES 10:61  And men of Israel, full of venom, came together against him, wicked men, asking against him, and (or but) the king took no attention to them;
1ST MACCABEES 10:62  and commanded Jonathan for to be made naked of his clothes, and him for to be clothed in purple; and they did so.
1ST MACCABEES 10:63  And the king setted him for to sit with him, and said to his princes, Go ye out with him into the middle of the city, and preach ye, that no man ask against him of (or about) any need, or cause, neither any man be heavy to him of (or for) any reason.
1ST MACCABEES 10:64  And it was done, as they that (had) asked, [or appealed (against) him], (or when they that had accused him), saw his glory that was preached, and him covered with purple, all fled (away).
1ST MACCABEES 10:65  And the king magnified him, and wrote him among the first friends, and putted him (a) duke, and partner, or fellow, of (his) princehood.
1ST MACCABEES 10:66  And Jonathan (re)turned again into Jerusalem, with peace and gladness.
1ST MACCABEES 10:67  In the hundred year and five and sixtieth, Demetrius, the son of Demetrius, came from Crete into the land of his fathers.
1ST MACCABEES 10:68  And king Alexander heard, and was made full sorrowful, and (re)turned again to Antioch.
1ST MACCABEES 10:69  And Demetrius ordained Apollonius duke, that was sovereign of Celosyria (or who was the governor of Greater Syria); and he gathered his great host, and came to Jamnia; and sent to Jonathan, the highest priest, and said,
1ST MACCABEES 10:70  Thou alone against-standest us; I am made into scorn and shame (or reproof) therefore, for thou hauntest power in (the) hills against us.
1ST MACCABEES 10:71  Now therefore if thou trustest in thy virtues (or thy strength), come down to us into the field; and there assemble [or comparison] we together, for with me is (the) virtue (or power) of battles.
1ST MACCABEES 10:72  Ask thou, and learn who I am, and others that be in help to me, and which say, that your foot may not stand against our face, for thy fathers were converted into flight twice into (or in) their (own) land.
1ST MACCABEES 10:73  And now how shalt thou be able to sustain (the) multitude of horsemen, and so great host in the field, where is no stone, nor rock, neither place of fleeing?
1ST MACCABEES 10:74  Soothly as Jonathan heard these words of Apollonius, he was moved in (his) heart; and he chose ten thousand men, and went out from Jerusalem, and Simon, his brother, came to him into help.
1ST MACCABEES 10:75  And they applied (or pitched their) tents in Joppa, and it, that is, the people of Joppa, shutted out him [or shut him out] from the city, for Joppa was the keeping of Apollonius;
1ST MACCABEES 10:76  and he fought against it, that is, Jonathan fought against Joppa. And they were aghast, that were within the city, and opened to him; and (so) Jonathan wielded Joppa.
1ST MACCABEES 10:77  And Apollonius heard, and moved three thousand of horsemen, and much host; and went to Azotus, as making (the) way. And anon he went out into the field, for that he had (a) multitude of horsemen, and he trusted in them;
1ST MACCABEES 10:78  and Jonathan pursued him into Azotus, and they joined battle.
1ST MACCABEES 10:79  And Apollonius left in (the) tents a thousand horsemen behind them privily.
1ST MACCABEES 10:80  And Jonathan knew that ambush-ments were behind him, and they environed his tents (or his host), and casted darts into the people, from the morrow till to eventide.
1ST MACCABEES 10:81  Forsooth the people stood, as Jonathan commanded, and the horses of them travailed out.
1ST MACCABEES 10:82  And Simon led out his host, and joined (battle) against the legion; for-sooth (the) horsemen were made weary, and were all-broken of him, and fled.
1ST MACCABEES 10:83  And they that were scattered in the field, fled into Azotus; and entered into the house of Dagon [or into Bethdagon], their idol, (so) that there they should deliver themselves.
1ST MACCABEES 10:84  And Jonathan burnt Azotus, and (the) cities that were in compass thereof, and took (the) spoils of them; and he burnt in (or with) fire the temple of Dagon, and them that (had) fled into it.
1ST MACCABEES 10:85  And there were that fell by (the) sword with them that were burnt, almost eight thousand men.
1ST MACCABEES 10:86  And from thence Jonathan moved (his) tents, and applied them to (or encamped at) Ascalon; and they went out of the city against him in great glory.
1ST MACCABEES 10:87  And Jonathan (re)turned again to Jerusalem with his men, having many spoils.
1ST MACCABEES 10:88  And it was done, as king Alexander heard these words, he putted to yet for to glorify Jonathan.
1ST MACCABEES 10:89  And he sent to him a golden lace, either (an) ouch, (or clasp), as custom is to be given to (the) cousins of kings; and he gave to him Ekron, and all (the) coasts thereof in possession.
1ST MACCABEES 11:1  And the king of Egypt gathered an host, as gravel that is about the brink of the sea, and many ships; and sought for to wield the realm of Alexander in guile, and add it to his realm.
1ST MACCABEES 11:2  And he went out into Syria with peaceable words, and they opened to him cities, and came to him; for why king Alexander commanded (them) for to go out against (or to meet) him, for he was (the) father of the king’s wife.
1ST MACCABEES 11:3  Soothly when Ptolemy entered into a city, he putted keepings of knights in each city.
1ST MACCABEES 11:4  And as he nighed to Azotus, they showed to him the temple of Dagon burnt in fire, and Azotus, and other things thereof (that) were destroyed, and (the) bodies cast forth, and the burials of them that were slain in battle, which they made beside the way.
1ST MACCABEES 11:5  And they told to the king that Jonathan did these things, for to make envy to him; and the king was still.
1ST MACCABEES 11:6  And Jonathan came to the king with glory into Joppa, and they greeted them together; and they slept there.
1ST MACCABEES 11:7  And Jonathan went with the king till to the flood that is called Eleutherus, and (re)turned again into Jerusalem.
1ST MACCABEES 11:8  Soothly king Ptolemy wielded the lordship of (the) cities till to Seleucia, by the sea coast, and thought against Alexander evil counsels;
1ST MACCABEES 11:9  and sent legates (or ambassadors) to Demetrius, and said, Come thou, make we betwixt us (a) covenant, and I shall give to thee my daughter, whom Alexander hath, and thou shalt reign in the realm of thy father.
1ST MACCABEES 11:10  For it rueth me, that I gave to him my daughter; for he sought for to slay me.
1ST MACCABEES 11:11  And he despised him therefore, for he coveted the realm of him.
1ST MACCABEES 11:12  And he took away his daughter, and gave her to Demetrius, and aliened (or alienated) him(self) from Alexander; and his enmities were made known.
1ST MACCABEES 11:13  And Ptolemy entered into Antioch, and putted two diadems (on)to his head, of Egypt and of Asia.
1ST MACCABEES 11:14  Forsooth Alexander, the king, was in Cilicia in those days, for they rebelled, that were in those places.
1ST MACCABEES 11:15  And Alexander heard, and came to him into battle; and Ptolemy, the king, brought forth the host, and came to him in (or with a) strong hand, and drove him away.
1ST MACCABEES 11:16  And Alexander flew into Arabia, for to be defended there; soothly king Ptolemy was enhanced (or was exalted).
1ST MACCABEES 11:17  And Zabdiel of Arabia took away Alexander’s head, and sent (it) to Ptolemy.
1ST MACCABEES 11:18  And king Ptolemy was dead in the third day (after); and they that were in (the) strengths perished, of them that were within the castles (or villages).
1ST MACCABEES 11:19  And Demetrius reigned in the hundred year and seven and sixtieth.
1ST MACCABEES 11:20  In those days Jonathan gathered them that were in Judea, for to overcome the high tower, that is in Jerusalem; and they made against it many engines.
1ST MACCABEES 11:21  And some wicked men, that hated their (own) folk, went to the king Demetrius [or went to king Demetrius], and told to him, that Jonathan besieged the high tower.
1ST MACCABEES 11:22  And as he heard (this), he was wroth, and anon he came to Ptolemais, and wrote to Jonathan, that he should not besiege the high tower, but should come to him in haste, to speak together.
1ST MACCABEES 11:23  Soothly as Jonathan heard (this), he commanded for to besiege (it still); and he chose (some) of the elder men of Israel, and (the) priests, and gave him(self) to peril.
1ST MACCABEES 11:24  And he took gold, and silver, and cloth(es), and many other presents; and went to the king, to Ptolemais, and found grace in the sight of him.
1ST MACCABEES 11:25  And some wicked men of his folk (had) asked (or had spoken) against him;
1ST MACCABEES 11:26  and (yet) the king did to him, as they that were before him, did to him; and he enhanced (or exalted) him in (the) sight of all his friends,
1ST MACCABEES 11:27  and ordained to him princehood of priesthood, and whatever other precious things (that) he had before; and made him prince of his friends.
1ST MACCABEES 11:28  And Jonathan asked of the king, that he should make Judea free, and (also the) three princehoods of three places, and Samaria, and nigh coasts thereof; and he promised to him (in return) three hundred talents.
1ST MACCABEES 11:29  And the king consented, and wrote to Jonathan epistles of (or about) all these things, containing (or in) this manner.
1ST MACCABEES 11:30  King Demetrius to Jonathan, brother, health, and to the folk of (the) Jews.
1ST MACCABEES 11:31  The ensample (or copy) of (the) epistle, which we have written to Lasthenes, our father, of (or about) you, we sent to you, that ye should know.
1ST MACCABEES 11:32  King Demetrius to Lasthenes, father (or our kinsman), health.
1ST MACCABEES 11:33  To the people of (the) Jews, our friends, and keeping which things be just with us, we deemed for to do well, for (the) benignity of them that they have with us.
1ST MACCABEES 11:34  Therefore we ordained to them, all the coasts of Judea, and (the) three cities of offerings, Lydda, and Ramath-aim, and Apherema, that be added to Judea, and (or from) Samaria, and all the nigh coast of them, for to be sequestered, or parted, to all men doing sacrifice in Jerusalem, for these things that the king took before of (or received from) them by all years, and for (the) fruits of the earth, and of apples.
1ST MACCABEES 11:35  And of other things that pertained to us, of tithes, and tributes, from this time (forth) we forgive to them; and the plain places of salt-making, and the crowns that were borne to us (or the crown taxes, that be due to us), all things we grant to them;
1ST MACCABEES 11:36  and nothing of these shall be void, from this time and into all time.
1ST MACCABEES 11:37  Now therefore busy ye for to make (an) ensample (or a copy) of these things, and be it given to Jonathan, and be (it) put in the holy mount, and in the solemn [or the holy] place.
1ST MACCABEES 11:38  And king Demetrius saw, that the land was still in his sight, and that nothing against-stood him, and left (or let go) all his host, each man into his (own) place, except the strange host (or except for the host of strangers, or of foreigners), that he drew from (the) isles of (the) heathen men; and all the hosts of his fathers were enemies to him.
1ST MACCABEES 11:39  Forsooth one Tryphon was of the parts of Alexander before, and he saw that all the host grumbled against Demetrius; and he went to Imalcue (the) Arabian, that nourished (up), (or nursed) Antiochus, the son of Alexander.
1ST MACCABEES 11:40  And he made great instance (or great insistence) to him, that he should betake him to him, for to reign instead of his father; and [he] told out to him, how great things Demetrius had done, and the enmities of his hosts against him; and he dwelt there many days.
1ST MACCABEES 11:41  And Jonathan sent to king Demetrius, that he should cast out them, that were in the high tower in Jerusalem, and which were in (the) helps, or strengths, (or strongholds), for they impugned Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 11:42  And Demetrius sent to Jonathan, and said, Not only this I shall do to (or for) thee, and thy folk, but I shall make thee noble by glory, and thy folk, when it shall be covenable (or opportune).
1ST MACCABEES 11:43  Now therefore rightly thou shalt do, if thou shalt send men in to help to me, for all mine host went away.
1ST MACCABEES 11:44  And Jonathan sent to him three thousand of strong men, to Antioch; and they came to the king, and the king delighted in the coming of them.
1ST MACCABEES 11:45  And there came together that were of the city sixscore thousand of men, and would slay the king.

1ST MACCABEES 11:47  And the king called (the) Jews into help, and all came together to him, and all were scattered by the city; and slew in that day an hundred thousand of men,

1ST MACCABEES 11:49  And they saw, (they) that were of the city, that (the) Jews had taken the city as they would; and they were made unsteadfast in their soul, and cried to the king with prayers, and said,
1ST MACCABEES 11:50  Give to us right hands, and cease the Jews for to fight against us and the city.
1ST MACCABEES 11:51  And they casted away their arms, (or weapons), and made peace. And (the) Jews were glorified in the sight of the king, and in the sight of all men that were in his realm, and were named in the realm. And they went again into Jerusalem, having many spoils.
1ST MACCABEES 11:52  And king Demetrius sat in the seat (or throne) of his realm, and the land was still (or quiet) in his sight.

1ST MACCABEES 11:61  And from thence he went to Gaza, and they that were at Gaza closed (up) them(selves)(al)together, and he besieged it. And he burnt what things were in compass of the city, and spoiled it by (or for) prey.
1ST MACCABEES 11:62  And (the) men of Gaza prayed Jonathan, and he gave to them (the) right hand, either peace. And he took the sons of them in(to) hostage (or for hostages), or (as) pledges, and he sent them into Jerusalem, and walked through the country till to Damascus.

1ST MACCABEES 11:64  and he came against them (or he came to meet them). Forsooth he left Simon, his brother, within the province.

1ST MACCABEES 11:67  And Jonathan and his host applied to the water of Gennesar, (or encamped at the Lake of Gennesaret, or by the Sea of Galilee), and before the light they walked in the light [or the field] of Asor.
1ST MACCABEES 11:68  And lo! the hosts of aliens came against (or met) them in the field, and setted to him espies, (or men in ambush), in the hills. Soothly he came against (them) of (or on) the contrary part.

1ST MACCABEES 12:1  And Jonathan saw that the time helped him; and he chose men, and sent them to Rome, for to ordain and renew friendship with them.
1ST MACCABEES 12:2  And to (the) Spartans (or Lacedae-monians), and to other places, he sent epistles by [or after] the same form.
1ST MACCABEES 12:3  And they went to Rome, and entered into the court, and said, Jonathan, highest priest, and the folk of Jews, sent us, for to renew friendship and fellowship, by the former (times).
1ST MACCABEES 12:4  And they gave to them epistles to them by places, (so) that they should lead forth them [or lead them forth] into the land of Judea with peace.
1ST MACCABEES 12:5  And this is the ensample of (the) epistles, which Jonathan wrote to (the) Spartans (or to the Lacedaemonians).
1ST MACCABEES 12:6  Jonathan, (the) highest priest, and the elder men of the folk, and priests, and other people of Jews, to Spartans (or Lacedaemonians), brethren, health.
1ST MACCABEES 12:7  Now before epistles were sent to Onias, (the) highest priest, from Darius, that reigned with you; for ye be our brethren, as the rescript, [or (the) writing], containeth, that is under-put.
1ST MACCABEES 12:8  And Onias received the man, that was sent, with honour, and took (or received the) epistles, in which was signified of fellowship and friendship.
1ST MACCABEES 12:9  When we had no need of these, and had in comfort [or in solace](the) holy books that be in our hands, we had rather for to send to you,
1ST MACCABEES 12:10  for to renew brotherhood and friendship, lest peradventure we be made aliens from (or to) you; for why many times passed, since ye sent to us.
1ST MACCABEES 12:11  We therefore in all time without ceasing, in solemn days, and others, in which it behooveth, be mindful of you in (the) sacrifices that we offer, and in observances, as leaveful is (or as it is lawful), and beseemeth, for to have had mind of (our) brethren.
1ST MACCABEES 12:12  Therefore we be glad of your glory.
1ST MACCABEES 12:13  Forsooth many tribulations and many battles environed us; and kings, that be in our compass, fought against us.
1ST MACCABEES 12:14  Therefore we would not be griev-ous to you, neither to other fellows, and our friends, in these battles.
1ST MACCABEES 12:15  For we had help of (or from) heaven, and be delivered, and our enemies be made low.
1ST MACCABEES 12:16  Therefore we have chosen Numen-ius, the son of Antiochus, and Anti-pater, son of Jason, and sent (them) to (the) Romans, for to renew with them both friendship and former fellowship.
1ST MACCABEES 12:17  Therefore we commanded to them, that they come also to you, and greet you, and yield to you our epistles of (the) renewing of our brotherhood.
1ST MACCABEES 12:18  And now ye shall do well, answering to us to [or of] these things.
1ST MACCABEES 12:19  And this is the rescript, or (the) again-writing, (or copy) of (the) epistles, that Oniares (or that Arius), the king of (the) Spartans, sent (to Onias).
1ST MACCABEES 12:20  Oniares (or Arius) to Jonathan, great priest, health. (Arius king of the Spartans, or Lacedaemonians, to Onias, the great priest, greetings.)
1ST MACCABEES 12:21  It is found in (the) writing of (the) Spartans (or of the Lacedaemonians), and of (the) Jews, that they be brethren, and that they be of the kin of Abraham.
1ST MACCABEES 12:22  And now since we know these things, ye do well, writing to us of your peace.
1ST MACCABEES 12:23  But and we have again-written to you. Our beasts and our possessions be yours, and yours ours. Therefore we command (our legates), for to tell these things to you.
1ST MACCABEES 12:24  And (then) Jonathan heard, that the princes of Demetrius went out with much host, over that (than) before, for to fight against him.
1ST MACCABEES 12:25  And he went out from Jerusalem, and ran against (or met) them in the country of Hamath; for he gave no space to them, for to enter into his country.
1ST MACCABEES 12:26  And he sent espies into (or unto) the tents of them, and they (re)turned again, and told (him), that they ordained for to come over thither in (the) night.
1ST MACCABEES 12:27  And when the sun had gone down, Jonathan bade his men(to) wake (or to watch), and be ready in arms to battle all (the) night. And he setted keepers by compass of (or about the) tents;
1ST MACCABEES 12:28  and (the) adversaries heard, that Jonathan was ready with his men in battle, and they dreaded, and inwardly were aghast in their heart(s), and tended fires in their tents, as if they dwelled still in their tents, but they fled privily.
1ST MACCABEES 12:29  Forsooth Jonathan, and they that were with him, knew not till to the mor-row; for they saw (the) lights burning.
1ST MACCABEES 12:30  And Jonathan pursued them, and caught not them; for they passed (over) the flood (or river) Eleutherus.
1ST MACCABEES 12:31  And Jonathan turned to (the) Arab-ians, that were called Zabadeans; and smote them, and took spoils of them;
1ST MACCABEES 12:32  and joined in gathering together his host, and came to Damascus, and walked by (or through) all that country.
1ST MACCABEES 12:33  Forsooth Simon went out, and came till to Ascalon, and to the next strengths (or strongholds); and he bow-ed down into Joppa, and occupied it.
1ST MACCABEES 12:34  For he heard, that they would give (the) help (or the stronghold) to (the) parties of Demetrius; and he putted there keepers, for to keep it.
1ST MACCABEES 12:35  And Jonathan (re)turned again, and called together the elder men of the people, and thought with them for to build strengths (or strongholds) in Judea,
1ST MACCABEES 12:36  and for to build walls in Jerusalem, and for to raise a great height (or a mound), betwixt the middle of the high tower and the city, for to part it from the city, (so) that it were alone, and neither they buy, neither sell, (in it).
1ST MACCABEES 12:37  And they came together, for to build (up) the city. And the wall fell down (al)together, that was on the stream, from the rising of the sun; and he repaired it, that is called Caphenatha.

1ST MACCABEES 12:39  And when Tryphon thought for to reign at (or in) Asia, and take a diadem, and stretch out (his) hand into (or upon) Antiochus (the) king,
1ST MACCABEES 12:40  he dreaded, lest peradventure Jon-athan should not suffer (or allow) him, but fight against him; and he sought for to catch him, and slay (him). And he rose up, and went into Bethshan.
1ST MACCABEES 12:41  And Jonathan went out against him, with forty thousand of chosen men into battle, and came to Bethshan.
1ST MACCABEES 12:42  And Tryphon saw, that Jonathan came with much host, for to stretch out hands into (or against) him.
1ST MACCABEES 12:43  And he dreaded, and received him with honour, and commended him to all his friends; and gave to him gifts, and commanded to his hosts, for to obey to him as to himself.
1ST MACCABEES 12:44  And he said to Jonathan, Whereto (or Why) hast thou travailed all the people, when battle is not to us?
1ST MACCABEES 12:45  And now send again them [or send them again] into their houses. But choose thou to thee a few men, that be with thee, and come thou with me to Ptolemais, and I shall give it to thee, and other strengths, and host(s), (or other strongholds, and armies), and all sovereigns of offices; and I shall (re)turn, and I shall go away. For why therefore I came.
1ST MACCABEES 12:46  And he believed to him, and did as he said, and let go the host; and they went away into the land of Judea.
1ST MACCABEES 12:47  Forsooth he withheld with him(self) three thousand of men, of which he sent again into Galilee two thousand; soothly a thousand came with him.
1ST MACCABEES 12:48  Forsooth as Jonathan entered into Ptolemais, (the) men of Ptolemais shutted the gates, and caught (hold of) him; and slew by (the) sword, all that entered with him.
1ST MACCABEES 12:49  And Tryphon sent (an) host, and horsemen into Galilee, and into the great field, for to lose (or to destroy) all the fellows of Jonathan.
1ST MACCABEES 12:50  And when they knew that Jonathan was taken, and perished, and all that were with him, they admonished them-selves, and went out ready into battle.
1ST MACCABEES 12:51  And they saw that pursued, that thing was to them (to fight) for the life, and (they) turned (back) again.
1ST MACCABEES 12:52  Forsooth they came all with peace into the land of Judea. And they bewailed Jonathan greatly, and all that were with him, and Israel mourned with great mourning.
1ST MACCABEES 12:53  And all (the) heathen men that were in the compass of them, sought for to all-break them; for they said, They have no prince and helper; now therefore overcome we them, and take away from men the mind of them.
1ST MACCABEES 13:1  And as Simon heard, that Tryphon (had) gathered a great host, for to come into the land of Judea, and for to destroy it,
1ST MACCABEES 13:2  and saw that the people was in trembling and dread, he went up to Jerusalem, and gathered the people;
1ST MACCABEES 13:3  and admonished, and said, Ye know, how great things I, and my brethren, and the house of my father, have done, for (the) laws, and for holy things (or the Temple), (the) battles, and what manner anguishes we saw.
1ST MACCABEES 13:4  For love, [or For grace, or cause], of these things all my brethren perished for Israel, and I alone am left.
1ST MACCABEES 13:5  And now befall it not to me, for to spare my (own) life, [or my soul], in all the time of tribulation; for I am no better than my brethren.
1ST MACCABEES 13:6  Therefore I shall avenge my folk, and holy things (or the Temple), and our children, and (our) wives; for all (the) heathen men be gathered, for to destroy us, because of enmity.
1ST MACCABEES 13:7  And the spirit of the people was kindled together, as it (or as they) heard these words.
1ST MACCABEES 13:8  And they answered with (a) great voice, saying, Thou art our duke instead of Judas, and Jonathan, thy brother(s);
1ST MACCABEES 13:9  fight thou our battle(s), and all things whatever thou shalt say to us, we shall do.
1ST MACCABEES 13:10  And he gathered all (the) men fighters, and hast(en)ed for to end (or to finish) all the walls of Jerusalem, and [he] strengthened it in compass.
1ST MACCABEES 13:11  And he sent Jonathan, the son of Absalom, and with him a new host, into Joppa. And when he had put [or cast] out these men that were in it, he dwelt there.
1ST MACCABEES 13:12  And Tryphon moved from Ptole-mais, with much host, for to come into the land of Judea, and Jonathan with him in keeping (or his prisoner).
1ST MACCABEES 13:13  Forsooth Simon applied in Adida (or But Simon encamped at Adida), (over) against the face of the field.
1ST MACCABEES 13:14  And as Tryphon knew, that Simon rose (up), in the stead [or instead] of his brother Jonathan, and that he was to joining battle with him, he sent to him legates (or messengers), and said,
1ST MACCABEES 13:15  For (the) silver, that thy brother Jonathan ought (or owed), in (the) accounts of the king, (is the reason that) we (have) withheld him.
1ST MACCABEES 13:16  And now send thou an hundred talents of silver, and his two sons (as) pledges (or hostages), (so) that he not dismissed (or released) flee from us, and we shall again-send him (or let him go).
1ST MACCABEES 13:17  And Simon knew, that with guile he spake with him. Nevertheless he commanded the silver for to be given, and (the) children, lest he should take great enmity of the people of Israel,
1ST MACCABEES 13:18  saying, For he sent not to him (the) silver and (the) children, therefore he (Jonathan) perished.
1ST MACCABEES 13:19  And he sent the children, and an hundred talents. And he (Tryphon) lied, and dismissed not Jonathan.
1ST MACCABEES 13:20  And after these things, Tryphon came within the country, for to destroy it. And they compassed by the way that leadeth to Adora; and Simon and his host walked into each place, whither ever they went.
1ST MACCABEES 13:21  Soothly they that were in the high tower, sent legates, or messengers, to Tryphon, for to hasten (himself) to come by (the) desert, and send to them foods.
1ST MACCABEES 13:22  And Tryphon made ready all the multitude of horsemen, for to come in that night. Soothly there was full much snow, and (so) he came not (there, but instead went) into Gilead.
1ST MACCABEES 13:23  And when he nighed to Bascama, he slew Jonathan, and his sons, there.
1ST MACCABEES 13:24  And (then) Tryphon (re)turned, and went into his land.
1ST MACCABEES 13:25  And Simon sent, and took the bones of Jonathan, his brother, and buried those in Modin, the city of his fathers.
1ST MACCABEES 13:26  And all Israel bewailed him with great wailing, and they bemourned [or mourned] him (for) many days.
1ST MACCABEES 13:27  And Simon builded on the sepulchre of his father and his brethren an high building in (or to) the sight, with stone(s) polished, or fair dighted, (or hewn), behind and before.
1ST MACCABEES 13:28  And he ordained seven small buildings, broad beneath and sharp above, one against one, to (or for his) father, and mother, and four brethren.
1ST MACCABEES 13:29  And to these he putted about great pillars, and on the pillars (their) armours, to (or for) everlasting mind; and beside (the) armours ships engraved [or graven ships], which should be seen of (or by) men sailing in (or on) the sea.
1ST MACCABEES 13:30  This is the sepulchre that Simon made in Modin, (there) till into this day.
1ST MACCABEES 13:31  Forsooth when Tryphon made way with Antiochus, the young king, in guile he slew him,
1ST MACCABEES 13:32  and reigned in his stead; and [he] putted on him(self) the diadem of Asia, and made great vengeance in the land.
1ST MACCABEES 13:33  And Simon builded (the) strengths of Judea, and warded them with high towers, and great walls, and gates, and locks; and putted foods in (the) strengthenings (or the strongholds).
1ST MACCABEES 13:34  And Simon chose men, and sent to King Demetrius, (so) that he should make remission (or give forgiveness) to the country, for all (the) deeds of Tryphon were done by ravishing.
1ST MACCABEES 13:35  And king Demetrius answered to him to (or with) these words, and wrote such an epistle.
1ST MACCABEES 13:36  King Demetrius to Simon, highest priest, and friend of kings, and to the elder men, and folk of Jews, health.
1ST MACCABEES 13:37  We received the golden crown, and (the) baheu, that is, an ornament of (or for) the neck, made with gold rings, which ye sent, and be ready for to make with you great peace, and for to write to (the) provosts of the king, for to release to you what things we forgave;
1ST MACCABEES 13:38  for whatever things we ordain to you, be stable. The strengths (or the strongholds) that ye builded, be to you;
1ST MACCABEES 13:39  and we forgive ignorances and sins, till into this day, and the crown that ye ought (or also the crown tax that ye owe us); and if any other thing was tributary, either bound to tribute, in Jerusalem, now be it not tributary.
1ST MACCABEES 13:40  And if any of you be able for to be written together among our men, be they written together, and peace be betwixt us.
1ST MACCABEES 13:41  In the hundred year and seventieth, the yoke of (the) heathen men was taken away from Israel.
1ST MACCABEES 13:42  And the people began to write in tables (or on tablets), and common [or open] doings, in the first year under Simon, (the) highest priest, (the) great duke, and prince of (the) Jews.
1ST MACCABEES 13:43  In those days Simon applied to (or encamped at) Gazara, and environed it with tents, either men of arms, (or with armed men), and made engines, and applied (or set them close) to the city, and smote one tower, and took it.
1ST MACCABEES 13:44  And they that brake out, were within the engine in the city, and (then a) great stirring was made in the city.
1ST MACCABEES 13:45  And they went up, that were in the city, with their wives, and sons, on the wall(s), with their coats cut, and cried with (a) great voice, asking of Simon that right hands be given to them,
1ST MACCABEES 13:46  and said, Yield thou not to us by [or after] our malices, but by [or after] thy mercies, and we shall serve to thee.
1ST MACCABEES 13:47  And Simon was bowed, either folded, and fought not against them; nevertheless he casted them out of the city, and cleansed fully the houses in which were simulacra (or idols), and then he entered into it with hymns, and blessed the Lord [or blessing the Lord].
1ST MACCABEES 13:48  And when all uncleanness was cast out thereof, he setted therein men, that should do the law; and he strengthened it, and made an habitation to him(self).
1ST MACCABEES 13:49  Forsooth they that were in the high tower of Jerusalem, were forbid-den for to go out and go in, into the country, and buy, and sell; and they hungered greatly, and many of them perished for hunger.
1ST MACCABEES 13:50  And they cried to Simon, for to take right hands, and he gave (it) to them; and he casted out them from thence, and cleansed the high tower from defoulings (or defilings).
1ST MACCABEES 13:51  And they entered into it in the three and twentieth day of the second month, in the hundred and one and seventy year, with praising, and branches of palms, and instruments of music, either gitterns, (or citherns), and cymbals, and harps, [or psalteries], and hymns, and songs, for the great enemy of Israel was all-broken.
1ST MACCABEES 13:52  And he ordained, that in all years these days should be done with glad-ness. And he strengthened the hill of the temple, that was beside the high tower, and dwelt there, he, and they that were with him.
1ST MACCABEES 13:53  And Simon saw John, his son, that he was a man of battle, and he putted him duke (or leader) of all virtues, that is, warriors, and he dwelt in Gazara.

1ST MACCABEES 14:3  And he went, and smote the host of Demetrius, and took him, and led him to Arsaces, and he putted him into keeping (or into prison).

1ST MACCABEES 15:1  And king Antiochus, the son of Demetrius, sent epistles from (the) isles of the sea to Simon, the priest, and prince of the folk of (the) Jews, and to all the folk;
1ST MACCABEES 15:2  and those were containing this manner (or contents). King Antiochus to Simon, (the) great priest, and to the folk of (the) Jews, health.
1ST MACCABEES 15:3  For (as) some men bearing pestilence wielded the realm of our fathers, forsooth I will challenge the realm, and restore it, as it was before; I made a chosen multitude of host, and I made ships of war.
1ST MACCABEES 15:4  Forsooth I will go forth by coun-tries, (so) that I do vengeance on them that destroyed our country, and that made many cities desolate in my realm.
1ST MACCABEES 15:5  Now therefore I ordain, either confirm, to thee all offerings, that kings before me forgave to thee, and what-ever other gifts they forgave to thee;
1ST MACCABEES 15:6  and I suffer (or allow) thee for to make print, or smiting, of thine own money, in thy region, or country.
1ST MACCABEES 15:7  Soothly I suffer Jerusalem for to be holy and free (or I allow Jerusalem and the Temple to be free), and all arms that be made, and strengths (or strongholds), that thou hast made out, and that thou holdest, dwell to thee;
1ST MACCABEES 15:8  and all debt of (or owing to) the king, and those that be to coming of (the) king’s things, from this time and into all-time be forgiven to thee.
1ST MACCABEES 15:9  Soothly when we shall wield our realm, we shall glorify thee, and thy folk, and temple, with great glory, so that your glory be showed in all earth.

1ST MACCABEES 15:11  And king Antiochus pursued him, and Tryphon came into Dora, and fled [or fleeing] by the sea coast;
1ST MACCABEES 15:12  for he knew, that evils were gathered on him, and (that) the host forsook him.
1ST MACCABEES 15:13  And Antiochus applied on (or encamped at) Dora, with sixscore thousand of fighting men, and eight thousand of horsemen;
1ST MACCABEES 15:14  and he compassed the city, and ships came from the sea; and they travailed the city by land and (by) sea, and suffered (or allowed) no man for to enter, either [or] go out.

1ST MACCABEES 15:18  Soothly they brought also a golden shield of a thousand bezants.
1ST MACCABEES 15:19  Therefore it pleased to us for to write to (the) kings and countries, that they do not (do) evils to them, neither impugn them, and their cities, and their countries, and that they bear not help to men fighting against them.
1ST MACCABEES 15:20  Forsooth it is seen to us, for to receive of (or from) them the shield.
1ST MACCABEES 15:21  Therefore if any men of pestilence shall flee from the country of them to you, betake ye them to Simon, (the) prince of priests, (so) that he do vengeance on them by [or after] his law.
