2ND MACCABEES 14:31  And as he knew this thing, that he was strongly before-come, or espied, of (or by) the man, he came to the most and holiest temple, and he commanded to the priests offering customable (or the accustomed) sacri-fices, that the man be betaken to him.
2ND MACCABEES 14:32  And when they said with (an) oath, that they knew not, where he was that was sought,
2ND MACCABEES 14:33  he stretched forth the hand to the temple, and swore, If ye shall not be-take to me Judas bound, I shall draw down this temple of God into plain-ness (or even with the ground), and dig out the altar, and I shall hallow this temple to Liber (or Pater), or Bacchus, that is, (the) god of wine, the father.
2ND MACCABEES 14:34  And when he had said these things, he went away. Forsooth the priests held forth (their) hands into heaven, and called him to help that ever(more) is (a) for-fighter of the folk of them, and said these things,
2ND MACCABEES 14:35  Thou, Lord of all creatures [or Thou, Lord of university, or of all creatures], (or O Lord of all Creation), that of nothing hast need, wouldest (or desiredest) that the temple of thine habitation be made in (or among) us.
2ND MACCABEES 14:36  And now, thou Lord, holy of all holy, keep without end this house undefouled, that (just) a little (while) ago was cleansed.
2ND MACCABEES 14:37  Forsooth Razis, one of the elder men of Jerusalem, was accused to Nicanor; and Razis was a man, (a) lover of the city, and well-hearing (or well heard of) or and well-praising (or highly praised), that for affection, or love, was called (the) father of (the) Jews.
2ND MACCABEES 14:38  This man many times held purpose of continence in Judea [or in Jewry], and was appeased (or was satisfied) for to betake body and soul for perseverance, or lasting.
2ND MACCABEES 14:39  Forsooth Nicanor would show the hatred, that he had against (the) Jews, and sent five hundred knights, for to take him.
2ND MACCABEES 14:40  For he guessed, if he had deceived him, that he should bring in most death to (the) Jews.
2ND MACCABEES 14:41  Forsooth when (the) companies coveted for to fall into his house, and for to break the gate, and for to move to fire, when now he was taken, that is, was nigh the taking, he assailed himself with (a) sword;
2ND MACCABEES 14:42  choosing to die nobly, rather than to be made subject to sinners, and against his birth for to be led with unworthy wrongs.
2ND MACCABEES 14:43  But when by hast(en)ing he had given wound with uncertain stroke, and (the) companies betwixt (the) doors burst in, he ran again hardily to the wall, and casted down himself manly into the companies.
2ND MACCABEES 14:44  And when they gave swiftly place to his fall, he came by the middle of the knoll,
2ND MACCABEES 14:45  and yet while he breathed, he was kindled in heart, and rose (up). And when his blood with great flowing flowed down, and with most grievous wounds he was wounded, by running he passed the company; and stood on an high stone [or standing upon some high stone],
2ND MACCABEES 14:46  and now was made without blood, and embraced his entrails with both hands, and casted (them) forth on the companies, and called to help the lordshipper of life and spirit [or he in-calling the lordshipper of life and spirit], that he should yield again these things to him; and thus he was dead from life.
2ND MACCABEES 15:1  Forsooth as Nicanor found that Judas was in the place of Samaria, he thought for to join battle in (or on) the day of sabbath with all fierceness.
2ND MACCABEES 15:2  Forsooth when (the) Jews, that pursued (or followed) him by need, said, Do thou not so fiercely and heathenly, but give thou honour to the day of hallowing, and worship thou him, that beholdeth all things.
2ND MACCABEES 15:3  And he (who was) unblessed, asked, If there is a Mighty (One) in heaven, that commanded the day of sabbaths for to be done?
2ND MACCABEES 15:4  And when they answered, There is a quick (or a living) Lord [or There is one Lord], and he is mighty in heaven, that commanded the seventh day for to be done.
2ND MACCABEES 15:5  And he said, And I am mighty on (the) earth, which command armours, (or arms, or weapons) for to be taken, and needs of the king for to be fulfilled. Nevertheless he got not, for to perform counsel.
2ND MACCABEES 15:6  And soothly Nicanor was enhanced (or was exalted) with sovereign or masterful pride, and thought for to ordain a common victory of (or over) Judas.
2ND MACCABEES 15:7  Forsooth Maccabeus trusted ever-more with all hope, that help should come to him of (or from) the Lord,
2ND MACCABEES 15:8  and he admonished his (people), that they should not inwardly dread at the coming to (them) of (the) nations, but should have in mind the helps done to (or for) them of (or from) heaven, and now should hope that the victory should come to them of (or from) the Almighty.
2ND MACCABEES 15:9  And he spake to them of the law, and (the) prophets, and admonished (them) of (the) battles which they did before, and (so he) ordained, [or confirmed], them readier.
2ND MACCABEES 15:10  And so when the souls of them were raised (up), he showed (al)to-gether the falseness of (the) heathen men, and (the) breaking of oaths.
2ND MACCABEES 15:11  Forsooth he armed each of them, not by (the) strengthening of shield and shaft, but with (the) best words and admonishings, and expounded a sweven worthy of believe (or a dream worthy to be believed), by which he gladded all.
2ND MACCABEES 15:12  Soothly the vision was such. Judas saw Onias, that was (the) highest priest, a good man and benign, shamefast in sight, and mild (or meek) in manners, and fair in speech, and which was exercised in virtues from a child, holding forth the hands for to pray for all the people of (the) Jews.
2ND MACCABEES 15:13  After this thing, that also another man appeared, wonderful in age and glory, and in having of great fairness about him.
2ND MACCABEES 15:14  Forsooth he saw Onias answering for to have said, This is the lover of (the) brethren, and of the people of Israel; this is he, that much prayeth for the people, and [for] all the holy city, Jeremy (or Jeremiah), the prophet of God.
2ND MACCABEES 15:15  Forsooth he saw that Jeremy hath straight(en)ed (out)(or stretched) forth the right hand, and hath given a golden sword to Judas, and said,
2ND MACCABEES 15:16  Take thou the holy sword, a gift of (or from) God, in (or with) which thou shalt cast down the adversaries of my people Israel.
2ND MACCABEES 15:17  Therefore they were admonished with (the) full great words of Judas [or And so they admonished with words of Judas full good], of (or by) which (their) fierceness might be enhanced (or lifted up), and (the) souls of (the) young men be comforted (or strength-ened), and they ordained for to fight, and torment (al)together strongly, that virtue should deem of needs, or causes, for that the holy city, and (the) temple were in peril.
2ND MACCABEES 15:18  For why [or Soothly] for (their) wives, and (their) sons, and also for (their) brethren, and cousins, was less busyness (or less care), but the most and first dread was [for](the) holiness of the temple (or but their first and fore-most fear was for the holy Temple).
2ND MACCABEES 15:19  But not (the) least busyness (or care) had them that were in the city, for these that should assail, or fight together.
2ND MACCABEES 15:20  And when now all men hoped doom to be, and (the) enemies come [or and (the) enemies came], and the host was ordained, (and the) beasts and horsemen put together in covenable (or suitable) place(s),
2ND MACCABEES 15:21  Maccabeus beheld the coming of (the) multitude, and diverse apparel of armours, and (the) fierceness of (the) beasts, and he stretched out the hands to heaven, and called to help the Lord doing great wonders, which not by [or after](the) power of arms (or weapons), but as it pleaseth to him, giveth victory to worthy men.
2ND MACCABEES 15:22  Forsooth he said, calling to help in this manner, Thou Lord, that sentest thine angel under Hezekiah, king of Judea, and hast slain of (or in) the tents, either hosts, of Sennacherib, an hundred thousand fourscore and five thousand [or an hundred (and) four-score and five thousand];
2ND MACCABEES 15:23  and now, lordshipper of heavens, send thou thy good angel before us, in dread and trembling of (the) greatness of thine arm,
2ND MACCABEES 15:24  (so) that they dread, that come with blasphemy against thine holy people. And soothly thus he perfectly prayed.
2ND MACCABEES 15:25  Forsooth Nicanor, and they that were with him, moved to(wards)(them) with trumps and songs.
2ND MACCABEES 15:26  Judas forsooth, and they that were with him, called God to help by (or with) prayers [of acknowledging], and went together.
2ND MACCABEES 15:27  Soothly they fighting with (their) hand(s), but praying (to) God in (or with)(their) hearts, casted down five and thirty thousand, not less, and (were) delighted greatly by (the) presence of God [or by (or in) the presence of God greatly delighting].
2ND MACCABEES 15:28  And when they had ceased, and with joy (re)turned again, they knew that Nicanor had fallen, with his armours.
2ND MACCABEES 15:29  Therefore when (a) cry was made, and (a) perturbation was stirred, by (their) country(’s) voice (or in their own language) they blessed the Lord Almighty.
2ND MACCABEES 15:30  Forsooth Judas, that by all things in body and soul was ready for to die for (the) citizens, bade [or commanded], that the head of Nicanor, and (his) hand with the shoulder gird(ed) off, should be brought forth to Jerusalem.
2ND MACCABEES 15:31  Whither when he fully came, when men of his lineage were called together, and (the) priests to the altar, he called also them that were in the high tower.
2ND MACCABEES 15:32  And when the head of Nicanor was showed, and the cursed hand, which he holding forth against the holy house of Almighty God greatly gloried,
2ND MACCABEES 15:33  also he commanded (that) the tongue of (the) unpious Nicanor (be) cut off, for to be given to (the) birds gobbet-meal (or piecemeal); forsooth he commanded the hand of the mad man for to be hanged up against (or opposite) the temple.
2ND MACCABEES 15:34  Therefore all blessed the Lord of heaven, and said, Blessed be the Lord, that kept his place undefouled.
2ND MACCABEES 15:35  Forsooth he hanged up Nicanor’s head in the highest tower, (so) that it were (an) evident, or known, and open sign of the help of God.
2ND MACCABEES 15:36  Therefore all men, by common counsel, deemed in no manner for to pass this day without solemnity, but for to have solemnity [or worshipping] in (or on) the thirteenth day of the month Adar, that is said, by voice of Syria (or in the Syrian language), the first day of Mordecai.
2ND MACCABEES 15:37  Therefore when these things were done against Nicanor, and of those times when the city was wielded of (or by)(the) Hebrews, also I in these things shall make an end of (my) word(s).
2ND MACCABEES 15:38  And soothly if well, and as it accordeth to the story, this thing and I will (or I desire); if (or) else less worthily, it is to forgive [or to be granted](or to be forgiven) to me.
2ND MACCABEES 15:39  Soothly as for to drink evermore wine, either [or] evermore water, it is contrary, but for to use changeable, either[or]now one, now another, is delightable; so to men reading, if the word be evermore sought to (or for) each part, it shall not be covenable (or suitable), or pleasing; therefore here it shall be ended. Here endeth the second book of Maccabees, which is (the) end of the Old Testament[Here endeth the story of Maccabees, the which is the last book of the Old Testament]; see now the New Testament.
3RD EZRA 1:1  And Josiah made (the) pask (or the Passover) in Jerusalem to the Lord, and he offered (the) pask the fourteenth day of the month of the first month,
3RD EZRA 1:2  ordaining (the) priests by their whiles of days, clothed in stoles, or long clothes, in the temple of the Lord.
3RD EZRA 1:3  And he said to the deacons [or to the Levites], the holy servants of Israel, that they should hallow themselves to the Lord, in (the) setting of the holy ark of the Lord in the house, that king Solomon, the son of David, builded;
3RD EZRA 1:4  It shall not be to you no more to take it upon (your) shoulders; and now serveth to our Lord, and do ye (the) care of that folk of Israel, of the part after towns, and their lineages,
3RD EZRA 1:5  after (or according to) the writing of David, king of Israel, and after the great worshipful doing of Solomon, his son, in all the temple, and after your little fathers part of (the) princehood of them, that stand in the sight of the brethren of the sons of Israel.
3RD EZRA 1:6  Offer ye (the) pask, and maketh ready the sacrifices to your brethren; and do ye after the behest of the Lord, that is given to Moses.
3RD EZRA 1:7  And Josiah gave to the folk that was found there, sheep, of lambs, and of kids, and of she-goats, thirty thousand; calves, three thousand.
3RD EZRA 1:8  These gifts be given (out) of the king’s own things, after the behest of the Lord to the people, and to (the) priests, into (the) pask; sheep in number two thousand, and calves an hundred.
3RD EZRA 1:9  And Jeconiah, and Samaeas, and Nathanael, his brother, and Sabias, and Ochiel, and Joram, gave into (the) pask, five thousand sheep, and five hundred calves.
3RD EZRA 1:10  And when these things were nobly done, the priests and deacons [or Levites] stood, having therf loaves by lineages.
3RD EZRA 1:11  And after the parts of the prince-hood of (the) fathers, they offered to the Lord in the sight of the people, after those things that be written in the book of Moses.
3RD EZRA 1:12  And they roasted the pask with fire, as it behooved; and they soddened hosts in seething vessels and in pots, with well-willing.
3RD EZRA 1:13  And they brought it to all that there were of the folk; and after these things they made ready to (or for) themselves and to (or for the) priests.
3RD EZRA 1:14  Forsooth the priests offered inner fatness [or tallow], unto the hour was ended; and (the) deacons prepared to (or for) themselves [or and (the) Levites made ready to themselves], and to (or for) their brethren, and to (or) the sons of Aaron.
3RD EZRA 1:15  And men sacrificing [or the sacri-ficers] offered their daughters, after the order and the behests (or commands) of David; and Asaph, and Zechariah, and Eddinous, that was of the king;
3RD EZRA 1:16  and the porters by all the gates offered, so that none passed his gate. Forsooth their brethren prepared to (or made ready for) them.
3RD EZRA 1:17  And so those things, that pertained to the sacrifice of the Lord, be ended. In that day they did (the) pask,
3RD EZRA 1:18  and offered hosts upon the sacrifice of the Lord, after the behest (or the command) of king Josiah.
3RD EZRA 1:19  And the sons of Israel, that were found present, did in that time (the) pask, and the feast day of therf loaves by seven days.
3RD EZRA 1:20  And there was not solemnized such a pask in Israel, from the times of Samuel, the prophet.
3RD EZRA 1:21  And all the kings of Israel hallowed not such a pask, as did Josiah, and the priests, and deacons [or Levites], and (the) Jews, and all Israel, that were found in the commemoration, or mind-making, (or memory-making), at Jerusalem.
3RD EZRA 1:22  In the eighteenth year, Josiah reigning, this pask was hallowed.
3RD EZRA 1:23  And the works of Josiah be made right in the sight of the Lord, in (or with a) full dreading heart;
3RD EZRA 1:24  and those things forsooth that were about him be written, in the rather times of them that sinned, and the which were unreligious against the Lord, before, or more than, all heathen folk, and the which sinners sought not the words of the Lord upon Israel.
3RD EZRA 1:25  And after all this deed (or all these deeds) of Josiah, Pharaoh, king of Egypt, went up, coming to cast away in Carchemish upon Euphrates; and Josiah went into (the) meeting to (or of) him.
3RD EZRA 1:26  And the king of Egypt sent to Josiah, saying, What is to me and to thee, king of Judea?
3RD EZRA 1:27  I am not sent of (or from) the Lord (against thee), upon Euphrates forsooth is my battle; hastily therefore go down.
3RD EZRA 1:28  And Josiah was not turned again (or did not turn back) upon the chariot, but he endeavoured himself to over-come Pharaoh [or but (he) enforced to overcome him], not taking heed to the word of the prophet (Jeremiah), from the mouth of the Lord;
3RD EZRA 1:29  but he set to him battle in the field of Megiddo; and (the) princes came down to (fight) king Josiah.
3RD EZRA 1:30  And then the king said to his children, or (to his) servants, Moveth me away from the battle; forsooth I am greatly made sick (or very weak). And anon (or at once) his children (or his servants) moved him away from the battle array.
3RD EZRA 1:31  And he went up upon his secondary chariot; and coming to Jerusalem, he died, and was buried in his father’s sepulchre.
3RD EZRA 1:32  And in all Judah (or in all Jewry) they bewailed Josiah, and they that before-set with wives, wailed him unto this day; and this is granted to be done evermore in all the kindred of Israel.
3RD EZRA 1:33  These things forsooth be written in the book of (the) stories of (the) kings of Judah, and the glory of Josiah, and his understanding in the law of God, by all (the) deeds of the doing of him; for evenly those were done of (or by) him, and the which be not written in the book of (the) kings of Israel and of Judah.
3RD EZRA 1:34  And they that were of the kindred took Jehoahaz, the son of Josiah, and set him (as) king for Josiah, his father, when he was of three and thirty years (old).
3RD EZRA 1:35  And he reigned upon Israel three months; and then the king of Egypt put him away, (so) that he reigned not in Jerusalem.
3RD EZRA 1:36  And he polled (or taxed) the folk of (or for) an hundred talents of silver, and of (or for) a talent of gold.
3RD EZRA 1:37  And the king of Egypt set Jehoiakim, his brother, king of Judea and of Jerusalem;
3RD EZRA 1:38  and he bound the master judges of Jehoiakim, and taking Zarius, his brother, he brought him again to (or out of) Egypt.
3RD EZRA 1:39  Jehoiakim was of five and twenty years, when he reigned in the land of Judah and of Jerusalem; and he did evil things in the sight of the Lord.
3RD EZRA 1:40  After this forsooth Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, went up, and binding Joakim in a strong bond, brought him into Babylon;
3RD EZRA 1:41  and Nebuchadnezzar took and brought the holy vessels of God, and (made) sacred (or consecrated)those in his temple in Babylon.
3RD EZRA 1:42  Forsooth of his uncleanness and unreligiosity it is written in the book of the times of (the) kings.
3RD EZRA 1:43  And Joakim, his son, reigned for him; when forsooth he was ordained king, he was of eight(een) years (old).
3RD EZRA 1:44  Forsooth he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem; and did evil in (the) sight of the Lord.
3RD EZRA 1:45  And after a year Nebuchadnezzar sent (for), and brought him over into Babylon, together with the sacred vessels of the Lord.
3RD EZRA 1:46  And he set Zedekiah king of Judah and of Jerusalem, when he was of one and twenty years (old). Forsooth he reigned eleven years;
3RD EZRA 1:47  and he did evil in (the) sight of the Lord, and was not adread of the words that be said of Jeremy (or by Jeremiah), the prophet, from the mouth of the Lord.
3RD EZRA 1:48  And he adjured, or charged by oath, of (or by) king Nebuchadnezzar, forsworn went away, and his noll made hard, he over-passed the lawful things of the Lord God of Israel.
3RD EZRA 1:49  And the dukes of the Lord’s people bare them(selves) wickedly many things, and they did unpiously over all the wickednesses of (the) Gentiles; and they defouled (or defiled) the temple of the Lord, that was holy in Jerusalem.
3RD EZRA 1:50  And (the) God of their fathers sent by his angel to again-call them, for the which thing he spared to them, and to their tabernacles [or their tabernacle].
3RD EZRA 1:51  They forsooth scorned in their corners, and that day that the Lord spake, they were bobbing his prophets.
3RD EZRA 1:52  The which Lord is stirred to wrath upon his folk, for their irreligiosity. And the kings of (the) Chaldeans commanded, and went up,
3RD EZRA 1:53  (and) they slew the young men of them with (the) sword, about the holy temple of them; and they spared not to young man, nor to maiden, nor to old man, and to full waxen man (or to fully grown man); but also all they be taken into the hands of them;
3RD EZRA 1:54  and they took all the sacred vessels of the Lord, and the king’s coffers, and brought those into Babylon.
3RD EZRA 1:55  And they burned up the house of the Lord, and destroyed the walls of Jerusalem, and they burned (up) his (or its) towers with fire.
3RD EZRA 1:56  And they wasted all the worship-ful things, and brought them to nought; and they brought the people left of (or by) the sword into Babylon.
3RD EZRA 1:57  And they were his thralls, unto the time that (the) Persians reigned, in the fulfilling of the word of the Lord, in the mouth of Jeremy;
3RD EZRA 1:58  till that the land would do benignly their sabbaths, he sabbatized all the time of their forsaking, in the applying of seventy years.
3RD EZRA 2:1  Reigning Cyrus, king of Persia, in the fulfilling of the word of the Lord, in the mouth of Jeremy (or Jeremiah),
3RD EZRA 2:2  the Lord raised up the spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia; and he preached in(to) all his realm (al)together by scripture (or by writing),
3RD EZRA 2:3  saying, These things saith Cyrus, king of Persia, The Lord of Israel, the high Lord, hath ordained me king to the world of earths (or over the whole earth);
3RD EZRA 2:4  and he signified to me to build to (or for) him an house in Jerusalem, that is in Judah.
3RD EZRA 2:5  If there is any man of your kindred, his Lord go up with him into Jerusalem.
3RD EZRA 2:6  Therefore how many ever dwell in places about, help they them that dwell in that place, in gold and silver,
3RD EZRA 2:7  in gifts, with horse(s), and beasts, and with other things, the which after vows be laid up into the house of the Lord, that is in Jerusalem.
3RD EZRA 2:8  And the standing princes of (the) lineages of (the) towns of Judah, of the lineage of Benjamin, and priests and deacons [or Levites], whom the Lord stirred to wend [or to go] up, and to build up the house of the Lord, that is in Jerusalem;
3RD EZRA 2:9  and they, that were in the environ, or in (the) compass, of them, should help in (or with) all silver and gold of it, and in (or with) beasts, and in (or with) many vows; and many others, of whom the wit is stirred, help they also.
3RD EZRA 2:10  And king Cyrus brought forth the sacred vessels of the Lord, the which Nebuchadnezzar translated (or brought over) from Jerusalem, and (had made) sacred (or consecrated) them in his (temple of) maumet(s).
3RD EZRA 2:11  And Cyrus, king of Persia, bringing them forth, took those to Mithradates, that was upon (or over) the treasures of him.
3RD EZRA 2:12  Forsooth by him they be taken to Sanabassar, governor of Judea.
3RD EZRA 2:13  Of these things forsooth this is the number; silvern hallowed vessels of liquors (or for liquids), two thousand and four hundred; thirty silvern drink-ing vessels; thirty golden vials (or phials); and two thousand and four hundred silvern vials (or phials); and a thousand other vessels.
3RD EZRA 2:14  Forsooth all the golden and silvern vessels were four thousand and four hundred and eight and sixty.
3RD EZRA 2:15  And they be delivered out to Sanabassar, together with them, that were come into Jerusalem of the captivity, or thralldom, of Babylon.
3RD EZRA 2:16  Forsooth in the time of Artaxerxes, king of Persia, there wrote to him, of these that dwelled in Judea and in Jerusalem, Belemus, and Mithradates, and Tabellius, and Rathymus, Beelteth-mus, and Semellius, the scribe, and others dwelling in Samaria, and in other places, they wrote this subject letter to king Artaxerxes.
3RD EZRA 2:17  Lord, thy children (or thy servants) Rathymus, and Semellius, the scribe, and other doomsmen of thy court, of things that fall in Celosyria and Phenice (or in Greater Syria and Phoenicia).
3RD EZRA 2:18  And now be it known to the lord the king, that (the) Jews, the which went up from you to us, coming into Jerusalem, a city of fleers-away [or a city again-flown to], and a full evil city, they build up the ovens of it, and they (re)set the walls, and rear (or raise up) the temple.
3RD EZRA 2:19  That if this city and walls were made up (again), [or were full ended], they shall not suffer to yield tributes, but also they shall against-stand to kings.
3RD EZRA 2:20  And for cause that that thing is done about the temple, to have it rightly we have deemed to not despise that same thing,
3RD EZRA 2:21  but to make known to the lord [the] king, that if it shall be seen pleasing to the king, be it sought in the books of thy fathers;
3RD EZRA 2:22  and thou shalt find in (the) remembrances written of them, and thou shalt know, that that city was again-flown (or rebellious), and kings and cities smiting together,
3RD EZRA 2:23  and (the) Jews fleeing again (or rebelling), and making battles in it always; for the which cause this city was forsaken [or is desert(ed)].
3RD EZRA 2:24  Now therefore we make known to the lord [the] king, that if this city were built up, and the walls of it were areared, there shall be no coming down to thee into Celosyria and Phenice.
3RD EZRA 2:25  Then the king wrote again to Rathymus, that wrote those things that befell, and to Beeltethmus, and to Semellius, the scribe, and to others ordained sovereigns and dwelling in Syria, and in Phenice (or in Phoenicia), [or to others ordained, and dwellers in Syria, and Phenice], he wrote to them these things that be set under.
3RD EZRA 2:26  I have read the letter, that thou sentest to me. Therefore I commanded it to be sought; and it was found, that that city was always withstanding to kings,
3RD EZRA 2:27  and (the) men again-fugitive, and making battles in it; and most strong kings have been lordshipping in Jerusalem, and asking tributes of Celosyria and Phenice (or Phoenicia).
3RD EZRA 2:28  Now therefore I (have) command-(ed) to prevent those men to build up the city, and to look [or to purvey], that anything be not made hereafter; but that they pass not into full much [or go they not forth into more],
3RD EZRA 2:29  since they be of malice, so that grievances be not brought there to kings.
3RD EZRA 2:30  Then after these things were rehearsed (or read), that were written of (or from) Artaxerxes, the king, Rath-ymus, and Semellius, the scribe, and they that were with them ordained, enjoining, hieingly (or hastily) came into Jerusalem, with horsemen, and people, and with company; and they began to prevent (or to hinder) the builders. And they voided (or ceased)then from the building of the temple [in Jerusalem], unto the second year of the realm of Darius, king of Persia.
3RD EZRA 3:1  King Darius made a great supper to (or for) all his servants, and to all the master judges of Media and Persia,
3RD EZRA 3:2  and to all that weared (or wore) purple, and to governors, and to counsellors, and to prefects under him, from India unto Ethiopia, to an hundred and seven and twenty provinces.
3RD EZRA 3:3  And when they had eaten and drunken, and were fulfilled, they (re)turned again (home). Then king Darius went up in his little bed-place, and slept, and (then) was (a)waked.
3RD EZRA 3:4  Then those three young men, keepers of the body (or his body-guards), the which kept the body of the king [or that kept the body of the king], said one to another,
3RD EZRA 3:5  Say we each of us a word, that before pass (or surpass)in knowing; and whose ever word seem wiser than of another [or the tother], king Darius shall give to him great gifts,
3RD EZRA 3:6  and to be covered with purple, and to drink in gold, and to sleep upon gold; and he shall give him a golden chariot, with the bridle, and a mitre of bis (or fine linen), and a bie (or a band) about the neck;
3RD EZRA 3:7  and he shall sit in the second place from Darius, for his wisdom; and he shall be called Darius’ cousin.
3RD EZRA 3:8  Then each of them three writing his word, sealed (it), and put those under the pillow of king Darius;
3RD EZRA 3:9  and said, When the king hath risen, they will take [or they shall give] to him their things written, and whatever thing the king shall deem of (these) three, and the master judges of Persia, forsooth the word of him is wiser than of the others, to him shall be given the victory, as it is written.
3RD EZRA 3:10  One wrote, Wine is strong.
3RD EZRA 3:11  Another wrote, The king is stronger.
3RD EZRA 3:12  The third wrote, Women be strongest; truth overcometh forsooth over all things.
3RD EZRA 3:13  And when the king had risen up, they took their things written [or they took their written things], and gave those to him, and he read (them).
3RD EZRA 3:14  And he sent (forth) and called all the master judges of Persia, and of the land(of) Media, and the clothed men in purple, and the rulers of (the) provinces, and (the) prefects;
3RD EZRA 3:15  and they set in council, and the writings were read before them.
3RD EZRA 3:16  And the king said, Calleth the young men, and they shall show their words. And they were called, and they came in.
3RD EZRA 3:17  And Darius said to them, Show ye to us of these things that be written. And the first, that had said of the strength of wine, he began,
3RD EZRA 3:18  and said to them, Men! full sur-passing(ly) strong is wine; to all men that drink it, it beareth down the mind;
3RD EZRA 3:19  also it maketh the mind vain, both of (the) king and of the fatherless child; also of servant and of free men, of poor and of rich;
3RD EZRA 3:20  and it turneth all the mind into secureness, and [in] to gladness; and it remembereth not any sorrow and debt;
3RD EZRA 3:21  and it maketh all the entrails honest (or rich); and it remembereth not king, nor master judge; and all things it maketh speak by talent(s);
3RD EZRA 3:22  and when they have drunken, they remember not friendship nor brotherhood, and not long after they take (out) swords;
3RD EZRA 3:23  and when they have been drenched of (or drowned in) wine, and rise, they have no mind (or memory of) what things they did.
3RD EZRA 3:24  O men! whether wine is not surpassingly strong, that thus constrain-eth men to do? And this thing said, he held his peace.
3RD EZRA 4:1  And the next follower began to say, that said of the strength of a king,
3RD EZRA 4:2  O men! whether men be not sur-passingly strong, the which hold land and sea, and all things that be in them?
3RD EZRA 4:3  The king forsooth surpasseth above all things, and he hath lordship of them, and they do all thing(s), what-ever he will say to them.
3RD EZRA 4:4  And if he send them to fighters, they go, and destroy hills, and walls, and towers;
3RD EZRA 4:5  they be slain and slay, and they pass not the word of the king; for if they overcome, they bring to the king all things, whatever things they have spoiled evermore, and all other things.
3RD EZRA 4:6  And how many ever (or however many) bear not knighthood, nor fight, but ear (or plow) the land, again when they shall reap, they bring tributes to the king.
3RD EZRA 4:7  And he is(but) one (man) alone; and if he bid to slay, they slay; and if he bid them to forgive, they forgive;
3RD EZRA 4:8  and if he say them to smite [or and if he say to smite], they smite; if he say to outlaw, they outlaw; if he bid them to build, they build;
3RD EZRA 4:9  if he bid to throw down, they throw adown; if he bid to plant, they plant;
3RD EZRA 4:10  and all (the) folk and virtues (or hosts) obeish (or obey) to him; and over all these things he shall sit, and drink, and sleep.
3RD EZRA 4:11  These forsooth keep him about [or in environ keep him], and may not go each one (or be not able to go each one), and do their own works, but in his word men obeish (or obey) to him.
3RD EZRA 4:12  What manner wise surpasseth not the king before others, that thus is loosed? And he held his peace.
3RD EZRA 4:13  The third, that had said of women, and of truth; this is said(or he was called) Zerubbabel; he began to speak,
3RD EZRA 4:14  O men! the king is not great, neither many other men, nor wine surpasseth before; who is it then that hath lordship of them?
3RD EZRA 4:15  Whether not women, that have (be)gotten kings, and all the people, the which kings have lordship both of (the) sea and of (the) land, and of women they be born?
3RD EZRA 4:16  And they brought forth them that planted vines, of the which wine is made.
3RD EZRA 4:17  And they make the stoles, or long clothes, of all men, and they do glory to men, and men may not or be not able to be severed from women.
3RD EZRA 4:18  If they gather together gold and silver, and all fair thing, and see a woman in good(ly) array, and in good fairness,
3RD EZRA 4:19  they, forsaking all these things, take heed to her, and the mouth opened, they behold her, and they draw more to her than to gold and [or] silver, or any precious thing.
3RD EZRA 4:20  A man shall forsake his father, that nourished him, and his own land, and to a woman he joineth him(self) together,
3RD EZRA 4:21  and with a woman he liveth his life, and neither remembereth father, nor mother, nor the land of his birth.
3RD EZRA 4:22  And therefore it behooveth us to know, that women have lordship of us. Whether ye sorrow not?
3RD EZRA 4:23  And also a man taketh his sword, and goeth in the way to do thefts, and manslaughters, and to sail over the sea, and over floods (or on rivers);
3RD EZRA 4:24  and he seeth a lion, and he goeth in darknesses; and when he hath done his theft, and guiles, and ravens, he bringeth it to his lief (or to his love).
3RD EZRA 4:25  And again a man loveth his wife more than father or mother;
3RD EZRA 4:26  and many men be made mad for their wives, and many be made thralls for them;
3RD EZRA 4:27  and many perished, and were strangled, and many have sinned for women, [or and sinned, for women].
3RD EZRA 4:28  And now (be)lieveth me; forsooth a king is great, and his power [or for great is the king in his power], for all regions, or kingdoms about, be afeared to touch him.
3RD EZRA 4:29  I saw neverthelater (or neverthe-less) Apame, the daughter of Bartacus, the wonderful man [or the daughter of (the) wonderful man Bartacus], the secondary wife (or concubine) of the king, sitting beside the king at the right side;
3RD EZRA 4:30  and taking away the diadem (or the crown) from his head, and putting it on herself, and with the palm of her left hand she smote the king.
3RD EZRA 4:31  And over these things, the mouth opened, he beheld her, and if she laugh to (or at) him, he laughed, and if she were wroth to him, he glosseth (or he flattereth), or pleaseth, unto the time that he be reconciled [in] to grace.
3RD EZRA 4:32  O men! why be not women strongest? Great is the earth, and heaven is high, that do these things.
3RD EZRA 4:33  Then the king and the purpled men beheld either into (the) other; and he began to speak of truth.
3RD EZRA 4:34  O men! whether women be not strong? Great is the earth, and heaven is high, and the course of the sun is swift; it is turned in the compass of heaven, and again it runneth again into the same place in a day.
3RD EZRA 4:35  Whether he is not a great doer, that maketh these things? and truth great, and stronger before all things?
3RD EZRA 4:36  All (the) earth calleth inwardly (the) truth, also it blesseth heaven, and all works be moved and dread it; and there is no wicked thing with it.
3RD EZRA 4:37  (A) Wicked king, and wicked women, and all the sons [or all the works] of men be wicked, and there is not truth in them, and in their wickedness they shall perish;
3RD EZRA 4:38  and truth dwelleth, and waxeth into without end, and it liveth, and wieldeth, into worlds of worlds.
3RD EZRA 4:39  It is not with truth to out-take (or to accept) persons, and differences; but it doeth those things that be rightful [or rightwise], to all unrightwise and evil men; and all men be made benign in his works.
3RD EZRA 4:40  And there is not wickedness in his doom, but there is strength, and realm, and power, and majesty of all endurings above time. Blessed be the God of truth!
3RD EZRA 4:41  And then he left (off) in speaking. And all the peoples cried, and said, Great is truth, and it (sur)passeth before all others.
3RD EZRA 4:42  Then the king said to him, Ask, if thou wilt, anything moreover, than there be written, and I shall give (it) to thee, after that thou art found (the) wiser; and next to me thou shalt sit, and thou shalt be called my cousin.
3RD EZRA 4:43  Then said he to the king, Be thou mindful of the vow, that thou vowed-est, to build up Jerusalem, in the day in which thou took the realm;
3RD EZRA 4:44  and to send again (or away) all the vessels, that be taken from Jerusalem, the which Cyrus parted (or set apart), when he slew Babylon, and would send again those things thither.
3RD EZRA 4:45  And thou wouldest build up the temple, that Idumeans burned (up), for Judea is put out of their terms, or marches, of (or by) the Chaldeans.
3RD EZRA 4:46  And now, lord, this it is that I ask, and that I bid; this is the majesty that I ask of thee, that thou do the vow that thou vowedest to the King of heaven, of (or with) thy mouth.
3RD EZRA 4:47  Then Darius, the king, rising kissed him, and wrote epistles to all the dispensators, and prefects, and to men clothed in purple, that they should lead him forth, and them that were with him, all wending [or going] up to build Jerusalem.
3RD EZRA 4:48  And to all the prefects that were in (Celo)Syria and Phenice (or in Greater Syria and Phoenicia), and (in) Lebanon, he wrote epistles, that they should draw (up) cedar trees from the hill Lebanon into Jerusalem, (and) that they build up the city with them.
3RD EZRA 4:49  And he wrote to all the Jews, that went up from the realm in(to) Judea, for freedom, that any man of power, or master judge, and prefect, should not come over to the gates of them,
3RD EZRA 4:50  and each region, that they had hold (of), to be free from them; and that Idumeans leave up [or left] the castles of Jews, that they withheld (and that the Edomites should let go of the towns of the Jews, that they held),
3RD EZRA 4:51  and to give year by year twenty talents, into (the) making of the temple, unto the time that it be full(y) builded;
3RD EZRA 4:52  and each day to offer hosts upon the place of sacred things (or the altar), as they be commanded; to offer, by all years, (an)other ten talents;
3RD EZRA 4:53  and to all men, that go forth from Babylon, to make the city, as freedom were, both to them, and to the sons of them, and to [all] the priests that go before.
3RD EZRA 4:54  Forsooth also he wrote the quantity; and he commanded the sacred stole(s), or vestment (s), to be given, in which they should serve;
3RD EZRA 4:55  and he wrote (the) wages to be given to the deacons [or Levites], unto the day that the house should be fully ended, and Jerusalem made out;
3RD EZRA 4:56  and he wrote to all men keeping the city, to give to the builders lots and wages.
3RD EZRA 4:57  And he left (for) them (or he let go to them) all the vessels, that Cyrus had parted (or had set apart) from Babylon; and all things, whatever Cyrus said, he commanded it to be done, and to be sent to Jerusalem.
3RD EZRA 4:58  And when that young man had gone forth, raising his face toward Jeru-salem, he blessed the King of heaven,
3RD EZRA 4:59  and said, Of thee, Lord, is victory, and of thee is wisdom, and clearness (or glory), and I am thy servant.
3RD EZRA 4:60  Thou art blessed [or Blessed thou art], for thou hast given to me wisdom, and I acknowledge to thee, Lord of our fathers.
3RD EZRA 4:61  And he took the epistles, or (the) letters, and went forth into Babylon; and he came, and told to all his brethren, that were in Babylon.
3RD EZRA 4:62  And they blessed the God of their fathers, that gave to them forgiveness and refreshing,
3RD EZRA 4:63  that they should go up, and build Jerusalem, and the temple, where his name is named in it; and they joyed [full out] with musics and with gladness (for) seven days.
3RD EZRA 5:1  After these things forsooth there were princes chosen of (or from their) towns, that they should wend [or go] up, by houses, by their lineages, and the wives of them, and the sons and daughters of them, and servants and handmaidens of them, and their beasts.
3RD EZRA 5:2  And king Darius sent together with them a thousand horsemen, to the time that they brought them into Jerusalem, with peace, and with musics, and timbres, and trumps;
3RD EZRA 5:3  and all the brethren were playing. And he made them to go up together with them.
3RD EZRA 5:4  And these be the names of the men, that went up, by their towns, into lineages, and into (the) part of the princehood of them.
3RD EZRA 5:5  Priests; the sons of Phinehas, the sons of Aaron, Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), the son of Josedek, the son of Saraeas, (and) Joakim, the son of Zer-ubbabel, son of Salathiel, of the house of David, of the progeny of Phares (or Perez), of the lineage forsooth of Judah,
3RD EZRA 5:6  that spake under Darius, king of Persia, marvellous doing words, in the second year of his realm [or of his reign], in April (or Nisan), the first month.
3RD EZRA 5:7  Forsooth these it be, that went up of Judah from the captivity, or thralldom, of the transmigration, whom Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, translated (or brought over) into Babylon;
3RD EZRA 5:8  and each is (re)turned again into Jerusalem, and into all the cities of Judea, each into his own city, that came with Zerubbabel, and with Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua); Nehemiah, Zar-aeas, and Resaiah, Eneneus, Mardoch-aeus (or Mordecai), Beelsarus, Asphar-asus, Reeliah, Romelius, (and) Baana, one of the princes of them.
3RD EZRA 5:9  And the number from the Gentiles of them, from the provosts, or reeves, of them; the sons of Phoros, two thousand an hundred seventy and two; (the sons of Saphat, four hundred seventy and two);
3RD EZRA 5:10  the sons of Ares, seven hundred fifty and six;
3RD EZRA 5:11  the sons of Pahath-moab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve;
3RD EZRA 5:12  the sons of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four; the sons of Zathui, nine hundred forty and five; the sons of Chorbe, seven hundred and five; the sons of Bani, six hundred forty and eight;
3RD EZRA 5:13  the sons of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three; the sons of Astaa, three thousand two hundred twenty and two;
3RD EZRA 5:14  the sons of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and seven; the sons of Bagoi, two thousand sixty and six; the sons of Adin, four hundred fifty and four;
3RD EZRA 5:15  the sons of Ater (the son of) Hezekiah, ninety and two; the sons of Keilan and Azetas, threescore and seven; the sons of Azurus, four hundred thirty and two;
3RD EZRA 5:16  the sons of Annias, an hundred and one; the sons of Arom, thirty-two; the sons of Bassa, three hundred twenty and three; the sons of Arsiphurith, an hundred and two (or twelve);
3RD EZRA 5:17  the sons of Baeterus, three thousand and five; the sons of Bethlo-mon, an hundred twenty and three;
3RD EZRA 5:18  the sons of Netophah, fifty and five; the sons of Anathoth, an hundred fifty and eight; the sons of Bethas-moth, forty and two;
3RD EZRA 5:19  the sons of Cariathiarius, twenty and five; the sons of Caphira and Beroth, seven hundred forty and three; the sons of Pira, seven hundred;
3RD EZRA 5:20  the sons of Chadias and Ammidoi, four hundred twenty and two; the sons of Cirama and Gabdes, six hundred twenty and one;
3RD EZRA 5:21  the sons of Macalon, an hundred twenty and two; the sons of Betolio, fifty and two; the sons of Phinis, an hundred fifty and six;
3RD EZRA 5:22  the sons of Calamolalus and Onus, seven hundred twenty and five; the sons of Jerechus, two hundred forty and five;
3RD EZRA 5:23  the sons of Sanaas, three thousand three hundred and thirty.
3RD EZRA 5:24  Priests: the sons of Jeddu, the son of Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), among the sons of Anasib, nine hundred seventy and two; the sons of Emmer-uth (or Immer), a thousand fifty and two;
3RD EZRA 5:25  the sons of Phassurus, a thousand forty and seven; the sons of Charme, a thousand and seventeen.
3RD EZRA 5:26  Deacons [or Levites]; the sons of Jessue, and Cadmielus, and Bannus, and Sudius, four and seventy; all the number from the two and twenty year, thirty thousand four hundred and two and sixty; sons, and daughters, and wives, all the numbering, sixty thousand two hundred and two and forty.
3RD EZRA 5:27  The sons of priests, that sung in the temple; the sons of Asaph, an hundred and eight and twenty.
3RD EZRA 5:28  Ushers forsooth (or The porters); the sons of Salum, the sons of Atar, the sons of Tolmon, the sons of Dacubi, the sons of Ateta, the sons of Sabi, (in) all an hundred and nine and thirty.
3RD EZRA 5:29  Priests, serving in the temple (or The Temple servants); (the) sons of Esau, the sons of Asipha, the sons of Taboth, the sons of Keras, the sons of Susa, the sons of Phaleas, the sons of Labana, the sons of Aggaba,
3RD EZRA 5:30  the sons of Acud, the sons of Uta, the sons of Ketab, the sons of Gaba, the sons of Subai, the sons of Anan, the sons of Cathua, the sons of Geddur,
3RD EZRA 5:31  the sons of Jairus, the sons of Desan, the sons of Noeba, the sons of Chaseba, the sons of Gazera, the sons of Ozius, the sons of Phinoe, the sons of Asara, the sons of Basthae, the sons of Asana, the sons of Maani, the sons of Naphisi, the sons of Acum, the sons of Achipha, the sons of Asur, the sons of Pharakim, the sons of Baaloth,
3RD EZRA 5:32  the sons of Meedda, the sons of Coutha, the sons of Charea, the sons of Barchue, the sons of Serar, the sons of Thomi, the sons of Nasith, the sons of Atepha.
3RD EZRA 5:33  Solomon, the sons of him (or The sons of Solomon’s servants); the sons of Asapphioth, the sons of Pharida, the sons of Jeeli, the sons of Lozon, the sons of Isdael, the sons of Saphythi,
3RD EZRA 5:34  the sons of Hagia, the sons of Phacareth, the sons of Sabie, the sons of Sarothie, the sons of Masias, the sons of Gas, the sons of Addus, the sons of Subas, the sons of Apherra, the sons of Barodis, the sons of Saphat, the sons of Adlon.
3RD EZRA 5:35  All these were in holy serving; and the children of Solomon were four hundred fourscore and two.
3RD EZRA 5:36  These be the sons that went up to (or from) Thermeleth and Thelsas; the princes of them were Charaathalar and Alar;
3RD EZRA 5:37  and they might not tell out their cities, and their progenies, what manner they be; and of Israel, the sons of Dalan, the sons of Ban, the sons of Necodan, (six hundred and fifty-two).
3RD EZRA 5:38  And of the priests, that used (the office of the) priesthood, and were [not] found; the sons of Obdia, the sons of Accos, the sons of Joddus, that took Augia (as his) wife, (one) of the daughters of Barzillai, and they be called by the name of her;
3RD EZRA 5:39  and of these is sought the genealogy written [or the written genealogy] of the kindred, and they be prevented to use (the office of the) priesthood.
3RD EZRA 5:40  And Nehemiah said to them, and Attharias, that they take not part of the holy things, till the time that there arise a taught bishop, into showing (or revelation) and truth.
3RD EZRA 5:41  All Israel forsooth was twelve thousand (or All Israel twelve years of age and older), out-take (or besides) servants and handmaidens, two and forty thousand three hundred and sixty.
3RD EZRA 5:42  The servants of [them, and](the) handmaidens were seven thousand three hundred and seven and thirty (or forty); singers and singsters [or singeresses], two hundred and five and sixty (or forty);
3RD EZRA 5:43  camels, four hundred and five and thirty; horses, seven thousand six and thirty; mules, two hundred thousand and five and forty (or two hundred and five and forty); beasts under yoke, five thousand (and five hundred) and five and twenty.
3RD EZRA 5:44  And of those provosts, or reeves, by towns, while they should come into the temple of God, that was in Jeru-salem, to be avowed to rear up the temple in his place, after their virtue;
3RD EZRA 5:45  and the holy treasury to be given into the temple of works [or to be given into the temple (into) the holy treasury of works], were eleven thousand bezants, and an hundred priests’ stoles.
3RD EZRA 5:46  And there dwelled (the) priests, and deacons [or Levites], and others, that were of the people, in Jerusalem, and in the realm [or region]; and the holy singers, and ushers (or the porters), and all Israel, in their regions.
3RD EZRA 5:47  While the seventh month yet lasted, and when the sons of Israel were each in his own things, they came together of one accord into the porch (or open space), that was before the east gate.
3RD EZRA 5:48  And while Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), the son of Josedek, and his brethren, (the) priests, stood, and Zerubbabel, the son of Salathiel, and his brethren, they made ready an altar,
3RD EZRA 5:49  that they would offer on it burnt sacrifices, after those things that be written in the book of Moses, the man of God.
3RD EZRA 5:50  And there came to them of other nations of the land, and reared (up) the holy treasury in his (or its own) place, all the folk of the land; and they offered hosts, and burnt sacrifices of the morrowtide to the Lord.
3RD EZRA 5:51  And they did the feast of tabernacles, and a solemn day, as it is written in the law, and sacrifices each day, as it behooved.
3RD EZRA 5:52  And after these things they ordain-ed offerings, and hosts of sabbaths, and of new moons, and of all solemn days hallowed [or all hallowed solemn days].
3RD EZRA 5:53  And how many ever vowed to the Lord, from the time of the new moon of the seventh month, they took hosts to offer to God; and the temple of the Lord was not yet builded up [or yet was not built up].
3RD EZRA 5:54  And they gave money to masons, and to wrights, and drinks [or and drink] and meats, with joy.
3RD EZRA 5:55  And they gave cars (or carts) to (the) Sidonians and to (the) Tyrians (or the men of Tyre), that they should carry over to them from Lebanon wood cedar beams, and to make a navy into the haven of Joppa, after the decree that was written to them from Cyrus, king of Persia.
3RD EZRA 5:56  And in the second year (after) they came into (or back to) the temple of God, into Jerusalem; the second month Zerubbabel began, the son of Salathiel, and Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), the son of Josedek, and the brethren of them, and (the) priests, and Levites (or deacons), and all they that came from the captivity into Jerusalem;
3RD EZRA 5:57  and founded the temple of God, in the new moon of the second month of the second year, when they had come into Judea and to Jerusalem;
3RD EZRA 5:58  and set deacons [or Levites] from the age of twenty years (old) upon the works of the Lord. And Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), stood, (and) his son(s), and his brethren, all the deacons [or all Levites] together casting, and executors, or followers, of the law, and doing works in the house of the Lord.
3RD EZRA 5:59  And there stood (the) priests, hav-ing stoles, or long clothes, with trumps, and (the) Levites (or the deacons), the sons of Asaph, having cymbals,
3RD EZRA 5:60  together praising the Lord, and blessing him, after the manner of David, king of Israel.
3RD EZRA 5:61  And they sung a song to the Lord, for his sweetness and his worship into worlds, or ever (more), upon all Israel.
3RD EZRA 5:62  And all the people sung with trumps, and cried with (a) great (or a loud) voice, praising together the Lord, in the rearing (up) of the Lord’s house.
3RD EZRA 5:63  And there came many of the priests, and of (the) deacons [or Levites], and of (the) presidents after (the) towns (or the princes of the towns), to the elders that had seen the rather house (or the first Temple), and at the building up of this house, with cry(ing), and with great wailing;
3RD EZRA 5:64  and many with trumps, and great joy,
3RD EZRA 5:65  so that the people heard not the trumps, for the great wailing of the people. Forsooth there was a company singing worshipfully in trumps (or with the trumpets), so that it was heard afar.
3RD EZRA 5:66  And the enemies heard the lineages of Judah and of Benjamin, and came to know, what was this voice (or meaning) of (the) trumps.
3RD EZRA 5:67  And they knew, that they that were of the captivity builded, [or built], the temple to the Lord God of Israel.
3RD EZRA 5:68  And the enemies coming nigh to Zerubbabel, and to Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), and to the reeves of (the) towns, they said to them, We shall build together with you.
3RD EZRA 5:69  In like manner forsooth we have heard our Lord, and we have gone together from the days of Asbasareth (or Esarhaddon), king of Assyrians, that over-passed from hence, [or that went over hence], (or that brought us here).
3RD EZRA 5:70  And Zerubbabel, and Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), and the princes of the towns of Israel said to them, It (be)longeth not to us and to you together to build up the house of our God;
3RD EZRA 5:71  forsooth we alone shall build the house of our God, after those things, that Cyrus, king of Persia, commanded.
3RD EZRA 5:72  The Gentiles forsooth of the land living with them that be in Judea, and rearing up the work of building, and bringing forth both (their) espies and people, they prevented them to build up;
3RD EZRA 5:73  and they hindered (the) men, haunting the goings-to, (so) that the building should not be ended in all the time of the life of the king Cyrus; and they drew along the making-up by two years, unto the reign of Darius.
3RD EZRA 6:1  Forsooth in the second year of the realm of Darius, Haggai prophesied, and Zechariah, the son of Addo, a prophet, with Judea and in Jerusalem, in the name of the Lord God of Israel, upon them.
3RD EZRA 6:2  Then standing Zerubbabel, the son of Salathiel, and Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), the son of Josedek, they began to build up the house of the Lord, that is in Jerusalem; when there were nigh to them, (yea), (the) prophets of the Lord, and helped them.
3RD EZRA 6:3  In that time came to them Sisinnes, the under-little-king of Syria and of Phenice (or Phoenicia), and Sathrabuzanes, and his fellows. And they said to them,
3RD EZRA 6:4  Who commanded to you, that ye build this house, and this roof, and many other things (that) ye perform? and who be those builders [or the builders], that build up these things?
3RD EZRA 6:5  And the elder men of Israel had grace of (or from) the Lord, when the visitation of them was made upon them that were of the captivity;
3RD EZRA 6:6  and they were not hindered to build up, to the time that it were signified to Darius of all these things, and an answer were taken again.
3RD EZRA 6:7  This is the ensample of the letter, that Sisinnes, the under-(little-)king of Syria and of Phenice (or of Phoenicia), and Sathrabuzanes, and their fellows, rulers in Syria and in Phenice (or in Phoenicia), sent to the king. To king Darius, greeting(s).
3RD EZRA 6:8  All things be they known to the lord the king; forsooth when we came into the region of Judea, and went into Jerusalem, we found men
3RD EZRA 6:9  building a great house of God, and a temple of great polished stones, and of precious materials in the walls;
3RD EZRA 6:10  and those works busily in making, and to help, and to make wealsome in the hands of them, and in all glory, full diligently to be performed.
3RD EZRA 6:11  Then we asked the elder men, saying, Who suffered (or allowed) you to build this house, and to build [or (to) found] these works?
3RD EZRA 6:12  Therefore forsooth we asked them, (so) that we might make known to thee the men, and the provosts, or reeves; and we asked them the writing of the names of the masters of the work.
3RD EZRA 6:13  And they answered to us, saying, We be servants of the Lord, that made both heaven and earth [or that made heaven and earth];
3RD EZRA 6:14  and this house was builded [or built] before these many years of (or by) the king of Israel, that was great, and a full strong king, and it was destroyed again[or full ended].
3RD EZRA 6:15  And for our fathers stirred and sinned against [the] God of Israel, he betook them into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, king of (the) Chaldeans;
3RD EZRA 6:16  and they destroyed and burned up this house, and they brought the people made thrall [or captive] into Babylon.
3RD EZRA 6:17  In the first year reigning Cyrus, king of Babylon, king Cyrus wrote to build up this house;
3RD EZRA 6:18  and those holy golden vessels and silvern, that Nebuchadnezzar had borne away from the house of God, that is in Jerusalem, and had (made) sacred (or had consecrated) them in his temple, again king Cyrus brought them forth from the temple that was in Babylon, and they were betaken to Zerubbabel, and to Sanabassar, the under-little-king.
3RD EZRA 6:19  And it was commanded to them, that they offer these vessels, and they should lay them up in the temple, that was in Jerusalem, and to build up that temple of God in that place.
3RD EZRA 6:20  Then Sanabassar under-laid the foundaments of the house of the Lord, that is in Jerusalem; and from thence unto now is (still) abuilding, and hath taken no full ending.
3RD EZRA 6:21  Now then, O king! if it is deemed of (or by) thee, that it be perfectly sought [or be it perfectly sought] in the king’s libraries of king Cyrus, that be in Babylon;
3RD EZRA 6:22  and if it were found in the counsel of king Cyrus, (that) the making of the house of the Lord, that is in Jerusalem, to be begun, and if it shall be showed of (or by) the lord our king, write he to us of these things.
3RD EZRA 6:23  Then king Darius commanded to be inwardly sought in the libraries; and there was found in Ecbatana, a borough town, that is in the middle region, a place (or a roll), in the which were written these things.
3RD EZRA 6:24  The first year reigning Cyrus king, Cyrus commanded to build up the house of the Lord, that is in Jerusalem, where they burned with continual fire;
3RD EZRA 6:25  whose height was made of sixty cubits, and the breadth of sixty cubits, squared with three polished stones, and with solar (or throne) tree of the same region, and with one new solar (or with three rows of polished stones, and one row of new wood from the same region); and costs to be given (out) of the house of king Cyrus;
3RD EZRA 6:26  and the holy vessels of the house of the Lord, both golden and silvern, that Nebuchadnezzar bare away, that those [or they] be put thither into the house, that is in Jerusalem, where they were put.
3RD EZRA 6:27  And he commanded Sisinnes, the under-little-king of Syria and Phenice (or Phoenicia), and Sathrabuzanes, and his fellows, to do their(own) business, and they that were in Syria and Phenice (or Phoenicia) ordained rulers, that they should abstain them(selves) from the same place.
3RD EZRA 6:28  And I also commanded to make (or build)it up all (again), and I looked forth, that they help them that be of the captivity of (the) Jews, unto the time that the temple of the house of the Lord be full(y) ended (or finished);
3RD EZRA 6:29  and a quantity to be given dili-gently to these men of the travail of the tributes of Celosyria and Phenice (or taxes of Greater Syria and Phoenicia), to the sacrifice of the Lord, to Zerubbabel, the prefect, to bulls, and wethers (or rams), and to lambs;
3RD EZRA 6:30  also forsooth both wheat, and salt, wine, and oil, busily by all years, as the priests, that be in Jerusalem, ordained to be fulfilled each day, without any delay;
3RD EZRA 6:31  also that there be offered offer-ings of liquors (or liquid sacrifices) to the highest God, for the king, and for his children, and pray they for the life of them.
3RD EZRA 6:32  And be it denounced (or announced), that whosoever over-pass anything of these things that be written, either [or] despise (them), be there taken a tree of their own, and be they hanged thereon, and their goods be escheated (or forfeited) to the king.
3RD EZRA 6:33  Therefore also the Lord, whose name is inwardly called there, outlaw he each king and folk, that stretch out their hand to offend [or to hinder], or to evil treat that house of the Lord, that is in Jerusalem.
3RD EZRA 6:34  I, king Darius, have made a decree, to be done as most diligently after these things.

3RD EZRA 8:1  And after this, while Artaxerxes, king of Persia, reigned, there went to Ezra, a man that was the son of Seraiah (or there came Ezra, the son of Seraiah), son of Azariah, son of Hilkiah, son of Shallum,
3RD EZRA 8:2  son of Zadok, son of Ahitub, son of Amariah, son of Azariah, son of Meraioth, son of Zerahiah, son of Uzzi, son of Bukki, son of Abishua, son of Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron, the first priest.
3RD EZRA 8:3  This Ezra went up from Babylon, when he was (a) scribe, and witty, (or witting, or knowing) in the law of Moses, the which was given of (or by) the Lord of Israel, to say it and do it.
3RD EZRA 8:4  And the king gave to him glory, that he had found grace in all dignity, and in desire, in the sight of him.

3RD EZRA 8:89  Lord God of Israel, thou art sooth-fast; forsooth the root is forsaken, unto the day that is now.
3RD EZRA 8:90  Lo! now we be in thy sight in our wickednesses; forsooth it is not yet to stand before thee in these things.
3RD EZRA 8:91  And when Ezra honouring (or worshipping) acknowledged, weeping, he fell down to the earth before the temple, there be gathered before him a full great multitude of Jerusalem [or be gathered before him of Jerusalem a full great company or crowd], men, and women, and young men, and young women; forsooth the weeping was great in that multitude.
3RD EZRA 8:92  And when Jechonias, the son of Jeel, of the sons of Israel, had cried, Ezra said, We have sinned against the Lord (or And then Jechonias, the son of Jeel, one of the sons of Israel, cried out, and said, O Ezra, we have sinned against the Lord), for that we have set with us into matrimony heathen women, of the Gentiles of the land.
3RD EZRA 8:93  And now whosoever is over all Israel in these things, be there to us an oath of (or to) the Lord, to put away all our wives, that be, with their sons, of the heathen folk;
3RD EZRA 8:94  as it is deemed to (or by) thee of the greater men, after the law of the Lord.
3RD EZRA 8:95  Arise now up, and show [out]thy will; forsooth to thee abideth this need, and we be with thee; do manly.
3RD EZRA 8:96  And Ezra arising up, made the princes of (the) priests, and the deacons [or the Levites], and (or of) all Israel, to swear to do after all these things; and they swore.
3RD EZRA 9:1  And Ezra rising up from the fore-porch (or the courtyard) of the temple, went into the cell (or the room) of Johanan, the son of Eliasibus.
3RD EZRA 9:2  And he harboured there, tasted no bread, nor drank water, for the wickednesses of the multitude.
3RD EZRA 9:3  And there was made a preaching in all Judea and in Jerusalem, to all that were of the captivity (that they should be) gathered (together) in Jerusalem,
3RD EZRA 9:4  (And) Whosoever again-cometh not to the second or the third day, after the doom of the elder men sitting, his faculties shall be taken away, and (that) he be deemed alien (or stranger, or cast out) from the multitude of the captivity.
3RD EZRA 9:5  And all, that were of the lineage(s) of Judah and Benjamin, were gathered together, three days (later) in Jerusalem; this is the ninth month, the twentieth day of the month.
3RD EZRA 9:6  And all the multitude sat in the floor (or the open space) of the temple, trembling for winter then being.
3RD EZRA 9:7  And Ezra rising up, said to Israel, Ye have done wickedly, setting to you into matrimony heathen wives, (so) that ye add to the sins of Israel.
3RD EZRA 9:8  And now give ye to the Lord God of our fathers confession, and great worthiness;
3RD EZRA 9:9  and perform ye his will, and goeth away from the heathen folk of the land, and from heathen wives.
3RD EZRA 9:10  And all the multitude cried, and they said with a great (or a loud) voice, We shall do, as thou hast said.
3RD EZRA 9:11  But for the multitude is great, and the time is winter, and we may not stand unholpen, [or unhelped], (or without help), and this work is not to (or for) us of one day, nor of two; (for) much we have sinned in these things;
3RD EZRA 9:12  therefore stand the provosts of the multitude, and all that dwell with us, and how many ever have with them heathen wives;
3RD EZRA 9:13  and stand they nigh in the time that is taken [or in the accept(able) time of (or in) all place(s)], priests, and doomsmen, till that they lose (or turn away) the wrath of the Lord, of this need (or over this matter).
3RD EZRA 9:14  Jonathan forsooth, the son of Azael, and Hezekiah, (the son of) Thocanus, took after these things, and Mosollamus, and Levi, and Sabba-taeus wrought together with them.
3RD EZRA 9:15  And all that were of the captivity stood there, after all these things.
3RD EZRA 9:16  And Ezra, (the) priest, chose to him(self) men, (the) great princes, of the fathers of them, after the names; and they sat together, in the new moon of the tenth month, to examine this need (or this matter).
3RD EZRA 9:17  And it is determined of the men, that had heathen wives, unto the new moons of the first month.
3RD EZRA 9:18  And there be found mingled (or mixed) among of the priests, that had heathen wives;
3RD EZRA 9:19  of the sons of Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), the son of Josedek, and of his brethren, Mathelas, and Eleazar, and Joribus, and Joadanus.
3RD EZRA 9:20  And they laid (or put up)their hands, that they should (or would) put away their wives, and for to sacrifice a ram, into prayer for their ignorance.
3RD EZRA 9:21  And of the sons of Emmer, Ananias, and Zabdaeus, and Manes, and Samaeus, and Jereel, (and) Azarias;
3RD EZRA 9:22  and of the sons of Phaesus, Elionas, Massias, Ishmael, and Nathanael, and Okidelus, and Saloas.
3RD EZRA 9:23  And of the deacons [or the Levites], Jozabadus, and Semis, and Colius, who was called Calitas, and Phathaeus, and Judas, and Jonas.
3RD EZRA 9:24  And of the hallowed [or the sacred] singers, Eliasibus, (and) Bacchurus.
3RD EZRA 9:25  And of the ushers, Sallumus, and Tolbanes. (And of the porters, Shallum, and Telem.)
3RD EZRA 9:26  And of Israel, of the sons of Phoros, Jermas, and Jeddias, and Melchias, and Maelus, and Eleazar, and Asibias, and Bannaeas.
3RD EZRA 9:27  And of the sons of Ela, Matthanias, and Zechariah, (and) Jezrielus, and Jeremoth, and Aedias.
3RD EZRA 9:28  And of the sons of Zamoth, Eliadas, and Eliasimus, and Othonias, and Jarimoth, and Sabathus, and Zardaeus.
3RD EZRA 9:29  And of the sons of Bebai, Johannes, and Ananias, and Ozabadus, and Emathis.
3RD EZRA 9:30  And of the sons of Mani, Olamus, and Mamuchus, and Jedaeus, and Jasubus, and Asaelus, and Jeremoth.
3RD EZRA 9:31  And of the sons of Addi, Naathus, and Moossias, and Laccunus, and Naidus, Matthanias, and Sesthel, and Balnuus, and Manasseas.
3RD EZRA 9:32  And of the sons of Annas, Elionas, and Asaeas, and Melchias, and Sabbaeus, and Simon Chosamaeus.
3RD EZRA 9:33  And of the sons of Asom, Altan-naeus, Mattathias, and Bannaeus, and Eliphalat, and Manasseh, and Shimei.
3RD EZRA 9:34  And of the sons of Bani, Jeremiah, and Momdis, and Ismaerus, and Juel, and Mandae, and Paedias, and Anos, Carabasion, and Enasibus, and Mamni-tanaemus, and Eliasis, and Bannus, and Eliali, and Somis, and Selemias, and Nathaniah; and of the sons of Ezora, Sessis, and Ezril, and Azael, and Samatus, and Zambris, and Josephus.
3RD EZRA 9:35  And of the sons of Nooma, Mazitias, and Zabadaeas, and Edaes, and Juel, (and) Banaeas.
3RD EZRA 9:36  All (of) these (had) joined to them-(selves) heathen wives, and (now) left them (or let them go), with their sons.
3RD EZRA 9:37  And (the) priests, and deacons, and they that were of Israel, dwelled in Jerusalem in an one region (or dwelled in Jerusalem, and its vicinity), (in) the new moon of the seventh month; and the sons of Israel were in their abidings.
3RD EZRA 9:38  And all the multitude gathered together in the floor (or in the open space), that is from the east of the hallowed [or the sacred] gate.
3RD EZRA 9:39  And they said to Ezra, (the) bishop and reader, that he should bring forth the law of Moses, that was given of (or by) the Lord God of Israel.
3RD EZRA 9:40  And Ezra, the bishop, brought forth the law to all the multitude of them, from man unto woman, and to all the priests, to hear the law, in the new moon of the seventh month.
3RD EZRA 9:41  And he read in the floor (or the open space), that is before the holy gate of the temple, from the first light of the day unto even(ing), before men and women; and all they gave wit, (or thought, or understanding) to the law.
3RD EZRA 9:42  And Ezra, the priest, and reader of the law, stood [up] upon the treen (or the wooden) chair, that was made therefore.
3RD EZRA 9:43  And there stood with him Mattathias, and Sammus, and Ananias, Azariah, Uriah, Hezekiah, and Baal-samus, at the right side;
3RD EZRA 9:44  and at the left side, Phaldaeus, Mishael, Melchias, Lothasubus, Nabariah, and Zechariah.
3RD EZRA 9:45  And Ezra took a book before all the multitude; forsooth he sat before in worship (or in honour), in the sight of all.
3RD EZRA 9:46  And when he had assoiled the law (or had opened, or had expounded upon, the law), all they stood upright. And Ezra blessed the Lord God, alder-Highest God of (the) Sabbath, Almighty or all mighty.
3RD EZRA 9:47  And all the people answered, Amen. And again they raised up their hands, and falling down unto the earth, they honoured (or worshipped) the Lord.
3RD EZRA 9:48  And Ezra commanded, that these should teach the law, Jesus, (or Jeshua, or Joshua), and Annus, and Sarabias, and Jadinus, and Jacubus, and Sabba-taeas, and Autaeas, and Maeannas, and Calitas, and Azarias, and Jozab-dus, and Ananias, and Phiathas, (the) deacons [or Levites]. The which taught the law of the Lord, and in (or to) the multitude they read the law of the Lord; and each by himself, that under-stood the lesson, told it before them.
3RD EZRA 9:49  And Attharates said to Ezra (or And the governor said to Ezra), the bishop and reader, and to the Levites that taught the multitude, saying,
3RD EZRA 9:50  This day is holy to the Lord. And all they wept, when they had heard the law.
3RD EZRA 9:51  And Ezra said, Ye therefore, after ye be gone atwain, eateth all most fat things, and drinketh all most sweet, and send ye gifts to them that have not;
3RD EZRA 9:52  forsooth this day of the Lord is holy; and be ye not sorry, the Lord forsooth shall clarify us (or for the Lord shall glorify us).
3RD EZRA 9:53  And the deacons [or the Levites] denounced (or announced), or showed, openly to all men, saying, This day is holy; will ye not (to) be sorry (or resolve not to be sorrowful).
3RD EZRA 9:54  And then all they went away, to eat, and to drink, and to have plenty of meat (or food), and to give gifts to them that have not, whereof to eat plenteously.
3RD EZRA 9:55  Greatly forsooth they be enhanced in the words, with the which they be taught. And all they were gathered into Jerusalem, to make solemn the gladness, after the testament of the Lord God of Israel.
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:1  Lord God Almighty of our fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and of their just seed,
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:2  which madest heaven and earth, with all the adorning of those,
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:3  which hast marked the sea by the word of thy commandment, which hast (en)closed (al)together the depth, or the deepness, of (the) waters, and hast marked them to (or hast sealed them by or with) thy fearedful and praiseable name,
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:4  which all men dread, and tremble of the cheer of thy virtue, (whom all men fear, and tremble at the face of thy power, or before thy power,)
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:5  and the wrath, or the ire, of thy menacing on sinners is unsufferable, either may not be sustained.
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:6  Soothly the mercy of thy promise is full great and unsearchable, either may not be comprehended by man’s wit (or cannot be comprehended by one’s understanding);
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:7  for thou art the Lord most high over all (the) earth; thou art patient, or long-abiding, and much merciful, and doing penance, or repenting, on the malices of men. Truly, Lord, by thy goodness thou hast promised penance of forgiveness of sins, that is, forgiving of sins for (the) repenting of men;
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:8  and thou, Lord, that art God of just men, hast not set penance to just men, (as) to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, (yea), to them that sinned not against thee, (but thou hast appointed repentance unto me that am a sinner). (and thou, Lord, who art God of the just, hast not set penance for the just, for Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, yea, for those who sinned not against thee, but thou hast appointed repentance unto me, who is a sinner.)
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:9  For I have sinned more than the number is of the gravel of the sea;
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:10  my wickednesses be multiplied. I am bowed (down) with much bond(s), (or with many bands), of iron, and no breathing is to me; for I have stirred thy wrathfulness, and I have done evil before thee, and I have set (up) abominations, and I have multiplied offensions (or offences).
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:11  And now, I bow the knees of mine heart, and beseech goodness of (or from) thee, Lord.
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:12  I have sinned, Lord; I have sinned, and I acknowledge my wickedness.
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:13  I ask, and I pray thee, Lord; forgive thou to me, forgive thou to me; lose (or destroy) thou me not (al)together with my wickednesses, neither reserve thou evils to me without end (or forever).
PRAYER OF MANASSEH 1:14  For, Lord, by thy great mercy thou shalt save me (who is) unworthy, and I shall praise thee ever(more) in all the days of my life; for all the virtue, that is, all those orders of angels, of heavens praiseth thee (or for all the powers of the heavens praise thee), and to thee is glory into worlds of worlds. Amen.
